NXlMNYsCFa.evidence: Experiments on image classifiers, language models and robot policies, including ResNet-50 error prediction on a clean-and-shifted image mixture, held-out shift families in language and robotics, language-model answer routing, and grokking transformers.
NXlMNYsCFa.claimed_gains: Adding the profile score to entropy improves ResNet-50 error-prediction AUROC by 0.18, and late-layer alignment interventions in grokking transformers reduce mean post-fork grokking delay by 33%.

cQtzxcGovJ.one_liner: Converts real-app interaction traces into runnable, resettable, verifiable mock Android apps for phone-agent training and evaluation.
cQtzxcGovJ.problem: Real apps are hard to reset, scale safely and verify programmatically, while static screenshots and trajectories cannot generate new experience.
cQtzxcGovJ.method: PhoneWorld induces a usage-weighted interaction skeleton from observed pages, transitions and state-changing operations, translates it into a behavior-grounded app specification, builds the app through an autonomous build-inspect-repair loop, and synthesizes executable tasks with programmatic verifiers.
cQtzxcGovJ.key_idea: A usage-weighted skeleton from real traces becomes an app specification, which an automated build-inspect-repair loop realizes as an environment with programmatic task verifiers.
cQtzxcGovJ.evidence: 34 consumer apps across 16 domains, evaluations of general and open-source GUI agents, controlled SFT experiments alongside AndroidWorld, and RL under a matched budget.

Y0gG2ODJgu.one_liner: Estimates a distance-direction landscape of different-outcome probabilities and abstains from reporting regions without finite-sample support.
Y0gG2ODJgu.problem: Retrieving a few nearby different-outcome instances does not reveal whether they reflect a recurring local pattern or isolated observations in finite samples.
Y0gG2ODJgu.method: SACA characterizes evidence by prevalence, direction and reach, reports regional estimates only when finite-sample bounds meet the requested accuracy, and otherwise abstains. The resulting support deficits guide acquisition of outcomes from a pool of unlabeled cases.
Y0gG2ODJgu.key_idea: Finite-sample bounds gate which regions of the distance-direction landscape are reported, and the remaining support deficits direct which cases to acquire next.
Y0gG2ODJgu.evidence: Theory (a near-optimal landscape estimation rate, finite-sample guarantees for reach and reported regions, approximation guarantees for acquisition), synthetic data with known posteriors, and six real-world datasets.
Y0gG2ODJgu.claimed_gains: On synthetic data, mean pointwise landscape MAE falls from 0.037 for the binned regional proxy to 0.029 (about 22% relative), and on six real-world datasets about 19% more regions become reportable than the strongest baseline.

nAxw22bhEb.one_liner: Online deployment-time adaptation of a VLA policy that pre-compensates for robot execution errors using commanded-versus-executed motion residuals.
nAxw22bhEb.problem: VLA policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from the commanded action because of mechanics and operating conditions such as wear and payload changes.
nAxw22bhEb.method: Self-compensating VLA updates the policy online, without task rewards or labels, from the residual between the commanded action and the motion the robot executed. RoboStress is a simulation benchmark combining joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios.
nAxw22bhEb.key_idea: The policy is updated online from the residual between commanded and executed motion, so it learns to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors.
nAxw22bhEb.evidence: RoboStress simulation against base policies and training-time robustness methods, plus two physical robot arms with different usage histories and objects unseen in the demonstrations.
nAxw22bhEb.claimed_gains: Raises average task success by more than 30 percentage points on each of two physical robot arms, and achieves higher average success than base policies and training-time robustness methods on RoboStress.

Q0MRBPTAVT.one_liner: Adds a real-image exemplar with BELM-inversion latent trajectory to each GRPO group and uses dual rewards for photorealistic portraits.
Q0MRBPTAVT.problem: GRPO text-to-image post-training favors superficial aesthetics such as over-saturated colors and leaves AI artifacts and biological implausibilities, since it uses only self-sampled groups and reward signals insensitive to fine-grained portrait artifacts.
Q0MRBPTAVT.method: Inserts a real exemplar into each GRPO group and constructs its latent trajectory with BELM inversion so it joins relative comparison and policy optimization. Adds a dual reward, OmniReward for general quality and AI-Portrait for human-centric fidelity, and curates PortraitBench.
Q0MRBPTAVT.key_idea: A real image, inverted into a latent trajectory with BELM, is a group member in GRPO, anchoring optimization outside the model's own sample distribution.
Q0MRBPTAVT.evidence: Experiments against existing baselines on the curated PortraitBench; further details are cut off in the abstract.

FGFl9j5u4a.one_liner: Defines full justified representation+ (FJR+), a proportionality guarantee for approval-based committees that can be achieved and verified in polynomial time.
FGFl9j5u4a.problem: Checking whether a committee satisfies full justified representation is computationally hard, even though such committees can be found efficiently.
FGFl9j5u4a.method: FJR+ allows fractional weights when assessing underrepresentation so violations are detectable by linear programming. A greedy procedure with equal voter budgets selects a partial committee that can be completed arbitrarily while retaining FJR+, and the approach extends to approval-based participatory budgeting with arbitrary project costs.
FGFl9j5u4a.key_idea: Fractional weights in the underrepresentation test make violations detectable via linear programming, and an equal-budget greedy partial committee keeps FJR+ under any completion.
FGFl9j5u4a.evidence: Theoretical results: polynomial-time achievability and verification, sub-core membership, and priceability when enough candidates are approved.

K0INaZH2m1.one_liner: Combines PAVE model-task rankings from several auxiliary models by reference-guided voting to select LLMs without target-task evaluation.
K0INaZH2m1.problem: PAVE rankings from a single auxiliary model are unreliable for heterogeneous LLMs, because the same observations can give accurate comparisons in one parameter space and misleading ones in another.
K0INaZH2m1.method: RG-MAV uses evaluated reference tasks most informative for the target in each auxiliary model's parameter space to weight and combine model comparisons separately for each candidate pair; a proof links PAVE cosine similarity to agreement on performance ordering.
K0INaZH2m1.key_idea: Weight and vote across several auxiliary models' PAVE spaces using nearby evaluated reference tasks, justified by a bound that task agreement on model-pair ordering grows with PAVE cosine similarity.
K0INaZH2m1.evidence: Proof under explicit assumptions for a fixed auxiliary model; experiments on heterogeneous LLMs and target tasks from six domains, with robustness to specification-training seeds and auxiliary-model removal.
K0INaZH2m1.claimed_gains: RG-MAV reaches an average Kendall's tau_b of 0.677, versus 0.517 for a fixed best (abstract truncated).

xXMiQdKwL4.one_liner: Benchmark for predicting perturbation responses of subcellular RNA positions at single-molecule resolution, with Oracle and Joint tasks.
xXMiQdKwL4.problem: Gene-count predictors omit the RNA positions needed to model spatial responses to perturbations.
xXMiQdKwL4.method: 14 imaging datasets with 13.88 million cells and 3.65 billion RNA molecules; models generate target RNA populations in normalized 2D coordinates from source observations and a directed condition change. Oracle predicts coordinates given exact target counts and Joint predicts both; eight baselines are tested on perturbation and cellular-context holdouts.
xXMiQdKwL4.key_idea: Separate abundance from localization with Oracle and Joint tasks, scoring abundance error, target-gene coverage, and conditional spatial error under fixed holdouts.
xXMiQdKwL4.evidence: Eight baselines spanning source resampling, classical transport, and frozen foundation-model adapters, on fixed perturbation and cellular-context holdouts, plus within-dataset analyses.
xXMiQdKwL4.claimed_gains: Gaussian transport achieves the lowest Oracle spatial error on eight of eleven cellular-context OOD datasets.

9TPbyDlTXA.one_liner: Transports object-centric latents from one image to target camera viewpoints by relative pose, predicting per-object position, scale, depth, and appearance.
9TPbyDlTXA.problem: Producing multi-view object representations from a single image that preserve object correspondence across views, beyond merely generating novel-view images.
9TPbyDlTXA.method: PORT is a self-supervised object-centric model that transports each object latent according to relative camera pose to predict position, scale, depth, and appearance under different horizontal viewpoints, with object-level metrics and a protocol for cross-view latent transport.
9TPbyDlTXA.key_idea: Move each object-centric latent across viewpoints by relative camera pose while preserving object identity, so latents can be reused across views for 3D reasoning.
9TPbyDlTXA.evidence: An object-level evaluation protocol for cross-view latent transport, with demonstrations in robotic manipulation and Gaussian Splatting.

gecSwl5TiO.one_liner: On-policy self-distillation where the teacher is the same model with searched repeated layers, distilled into the student over alternating rounds.
gecSwl5TiO.problem: On-policy self-distillation needs a teacher that gives more useful predictions than the student, and existing approaches obtain it by adding context or instructions.
gecSwl5TiO.method: Keep the weights fixed while searching for layers to repeat, use the looped teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning, and alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student each round.
gecSwl5TiO.key_idea: Build the teacher by searching the layer execution order of the current model, distill its advantage into the student, and repeat with the updated student.
gecSwl5TiO.evidence: Mathematical and logical reasoning tasks across models, with GSM8K at a 400-token thinking budget on Qwen3-1.7B as the example.
gecSwl5TiO.claimed_gains: On GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, Qwen3-1.7B accuracy rises from 42.30% to 79.61%, with further gains in later distillation rounds.

EjgiqKhfDt.one_liner: Self-supervised variational diffusion for hyperspectral restoration, coupling a likelihood step with a Temporal Tucker prior step in reverse sampling.
EjgiqKhfDt.problem: Supervised HSI restoration generalizes poorly across sensors and corruptions, model-based priors are hand-designed, and existing diffusion methods model complex hyperspectral corruption and HSI-specific regularization poorly.
EjgiqKhfDt.method: VITTA couples a likelihood step, where a two-factor probabilistic model characterizes corruption and projects non-Gaussian uncertainty into Gaussian observation channels for reliability-aware conditioning, with a prior step using a Temporal Tucker Prior Module that estimates the clean endpoint under joint spatial, spectral, and reverse-step regularization.
EjgiqKhfDt.key_idea: Alternate reliability-aware likelihood conditioning with a temporal Tucker prior across reverse diffusion steps for self-supervised restoration.
EjgiqKhfDt.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before the experiments; not stated.

NrK7uYw5UY.one_liner: Context-aware MEG-to-text decoder that aligns MEG with words and conditions an LLM on preceding text as a semantic anchor.
NrK7uYw5UY.problem: Scarce paired MEG-text data prevents robust signal-to-text mappings, so prior approaches fall short in the open-vocabulary setting.
NrK7uYw5UY.method: CoMET aligns MEG signals with text at the word level, then maps these representations into the latent space of a large language model under contextual conditioning, with preceding context narrowing the textual search space.
NrK7uYw5UY.key_idea: Treat open-vocabulary decoding as context-guided inference: MEG carries the linguistic content and preceding text steers the LLM's decoding distribution toward relevant tokens.
NrK7uYw5UY.claimed_gains: Prior open-vocabulary decoders collapse to near random performance while CoMET reaches the best open-vocabulary decoding performance; no numbers stated.

5l0rJXRDLD.one_liner: Benchmark of production UI designs with expert requirement annotations for evaluating MLLM design-to-code beyond visual fidelity.
5l0rJXRDLD.problem: MLLM ability to link design images with disorganized layer metadata, infer implementation requirements, and realize them in code under library constraints is insufficiently evaluated in industrial settings.
5l0rJXRDLD.method: 2,861 production designs from 17 commercial platforms with 97,652 expert annotations over Component, Group, Alignment, and Position, separating required constraints from permitted choices; three tasks cover end-to-end UI code generation, requirement inference, and requirement realization.
5l0rJXRDLD.key_idea: Annotate which implementation constraints are required versus permitted, and evaluate requirement inference and realization separately from end-to-end code generation.
5l0rJXRDLD.evidence: Eight MLLMs evaluated on the three tasks.

p21589TI45.one_liner: Learns subgroup-level causal actions by reducing partial-intervention success probability to supervised learning under a partition-based outcome model.
p21589TI45.problem: Choosing which variables to intervene on, what values to set, and for which subgroup is hard because untouched variables respond through a causal graph that observational data do not identify.
p21589TI45.method: Under a partition-based outcome model the best action does not need the graph, and the problem reduces to supervised learning with a finite-sample regret bound controlled by prediction error; SCAT is a decision-tree instantiation, validated on a constructed semi-synthetic benchmark.
p21589TI45.key_idea: Under a partition-based outcome model, the optimal subgroup-level action follows from standard supervised prediction without knowing the causal graph, with regret bounded by prediction error.
p21589TI45.evidence: A finite-sample regret guarantee and a semi-synthetic benchmark (abstract truncated).

y66MjOTBw3.one_liner: Encoding candidate action prefixes to predict multi-horizon future latents in parallel replaces step-by-step rollouts in JEPA visual planning.
y66MjOTBw3.problem: Evaluating candidate action sequences in JEPA world models via repeated one-step autoregressive latent transitions is slow and compounds prediction errors over long horizons.
y66MjOTBw3.method: Given the current latent state and a candidate action sequence, Fast-LeWM encodes action prefixes and predicts the future latent states reached after executing those prefixes in parallel. Jointly training multi-horizon prefix predictions lets visual planning evaluate future latents directly without rolling through intermediate imagined states.
y66MjOTBw3.key_idea: Predict future latent states across multiple horizons in parallel directly from encoded action-sequence prefixes and the current latent state instead of chaining one-step transitions.
y66MjOTBw3.evidence: Evaluated against LeWorldModel across multiple visual planning tasks measuring task success and planning cost.

RKfwl41fws.one_liner: Benchmarks zero-shot generalization from benign manipulation skills to hazardous behaviors across 50 matched OmniGibson robot scenarios.
RKfwl41fws.problem: Advances in generalist robotic manipulation can inadvertently transfer benign physical primitives to harmful actions without task-specific adaptation, decoupling capability from safety.
RKfwl41fws.method: CHARM translates high-level safety constitutions into structured hazard schemas and uses an automated agent pipeline in the OmniGibson simulator to generate 50 matched benign-versus-hazardous task pairs built on shared manipulation primitives. It evaluates generalist robot policies across both halves of each pair to measure capability-to-harm transfer.
RKfwl41fws.key_idea: Pair benign and hazardous simulated manipulation tasks that share underlying motor primitives to test whether safe-trained robot policies generalize to unsafe execution.
RKfwl41fws.evidence: Evaluates 17 generalist robot policies across 50 curated benign-hazardous scenario pairs instantiated in the OmniGibson simulator.

crvRWS9kQs.one_liner: Converts raster flowcharts into aspect-ratio-adapted editable mxGraph XML using staged agents verified by deterministic and VLM critics.
crvRWS9kQs.problem: Retargeting raster scientific flowcharts to new aspect ratios causes generative models to distort blocks or hallucinate text and causes parse-and-render tools to misroute graph edges.
crvRWS9kQs.method: The pipeline decomposes flowchart retargeting into Parse, Style, and Layout stages that emit draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. Each stage pairs a generator agent with a critic combining deterministic graph-connectivity and layout constraint checks with vision-language visual feedback.
crvRWS9kQs.key_idea: Factor raster-to-XML flowchart relayout into Parse, Style, and Layout agent stages gated by hybrid deterministic-constraint and VLM visual critics.
crvRWS9kQs.evidence: Evaluated on a curated benchmark of 100 ML flowcharts across five target aspect ratios (including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16) using human-validated Gemini 3.1 Pro scoring.
crvRWS9kQs.claimed_gains: Reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity across five aspect ratios compared with 11.2–41.4% for prior methods.

MJE81EQgGk.one_liner: Quantizes diffusion transformer weights and activations without calibration data using randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotations and fixed Lloyd-Max codebooks.
MJE81EQgGk.problem: Diffusion transformer activations shift across sampling timesteps, prompts, and guidance branches, forcing conventional post-training quantizers to recalibrate ranges for every model or modality.
MJE81EQgGk.method: OrbitQuant normalizes and rotates activations and weights with a randomized permuted block-Hadamard transform that equalizes coordinate variances into a known marginal distribution quantized by a single shared Lloyd-Max codebook. Weight rotations are absorbed offline so they cancel linear-layer activation rotations, leaving only a forward activation transform at runtime.
MJE81EQgGk.key_idea: Apply canceling randomized permuted block-Hadamard rotations so normalized weights and activations follow a known marginal quantizable by one calibration-free Lloyd-Max codebook.
MJE81EQgGk.evidence: Evaluated across image and video diffusion transformers—FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, Wan 2.1, and CogVideoX—at W4A4, 3-bit, and W2A4 precision settings.

zyVVqalY7p.one_liner: Couples persistent rule-governed game state and contextual actor reasoning with action-conditioned audiovisual generation for playable FPS gameplay.
zyVVqalY7p.problem: Pure audiovisual world models lack persistent hidden state and autonomous rule-driven behavior needed for reciprocal combat and persistent consequences in gameplay.
zyVVqalY7p.method: RIGen integrates a persistent configurable game-state tracker and contextual interaction reasoner with an action-conditioned audiovisual generator so player actions and world-agent responses jointly determine rendered frames and audio. Using a curated Xonotic dataset and post-training, the authors build RIGArena, a playable generative arena first-person shooter.
zyVVqalY7p.key_idea: Maintain persistent rule-based game state and contextual NPC reasoning alongside action-conditioned audiovisual synthesis to close the player-world interaction loop.
zyVVqalY7p.evidence: Trained on a custom Xonotic gameplay dataset and evaluated in the post-trained playable RIGArena first-person shooter environment on combat reliability and reciprocal interaction.

Yl4jzPyl61.one_liner: Analytically profiles out state-dependent logit offsets during advantage regression to preserve local Fisher curvature in policy optimization.
Yl4jzPyl61.problem: Fixing arbitrary state-dependent logit offsets when fitting Boltzmann policy updates under function approximation distorts optimization curvature away from the local Fisher geometry.
Yl4jzPyl61.method: LOCAL analytically eliminates the state-dependent logit offset from policy mirror descent targets so neural policies regress only policy-relevant relative logit differences, recovering natural policy gradient under local linearization. A first-order formulation with a Top-K action approximation scales the objective to large discrete vocabularies.
Yl4jzPyl61.key_idea: Analytically profile out the state-dependent constant offset in logit-space advantage regression so function-approximated updates preserve local Fisher curvature.
Yl4jzPyl61.evidence: Theoretical curvature and linearization proofs plus empirical evaluations on Atari, Procgen, and LLM post-training under RLHF and RLVR against PPO and GRPO.

jxJ8inOja3.one_liner: Trains a 0.8B VLM for single-pass aesthetic image cropping via online best-candidate supervision and greedy-referenced quality optimization.
jxJ8inOja3.problem: Large vision-language models are computationally heavy for on-device photography cropping, while compact models underperform under standard greedy decoding despite sampling stronger candidates.
jxJ8inOja3.method: Built on Qwen3.5-0.8B, FrameLite runs three training stages: spatial-composition warm-up, Quality-Guided Online Supervision on top-scored self-generated crops, and Greedy-Referenced Optimization contrasting candidate quality against the current greedy output. At inference, the model predicts crop coordinates in one pass without candidate search or external scorers.
jxJ8inOja3.key_idea: Convert a compact VLM's multi-sample cropping potential into direct single-pass predictions via online best-of-rollout supervision followed by greedy-referenced contrastive optimization.
jxJ8inOja3.evidence: Evaluated on Qwen3.5-0.8B across public aesthetic cropping benchmarks against larger VLM croppers, with ablations isolating online quality selection.

NLCWJnak81.one_liner: Adaptively partitions and splits shared covariance groups across frozen protein embeddings for training-free Mahalanobis class-incremental classification.
NLCWJnak81.problem: Fixed covariance-sharing and projection schemes fail to generalize across frozen protein language models with heterogeneous embedding geometries as new enzyme classes arrive incrementally.
NLCWJnak81.method: ProtoCIL is a training-free Mahalanobis prototype classifier over frozen protein encoders that sets an initial number of shared covariance groups from embedding intrinsic rank and sample count. As new classes stream in, it incrementally refines the covariance partition through validation-guided group splits.
NLCWJnak81.key_idea: Determine initial shared-covariance group counts from embedding intrinsic rank and sample size, then split covariance groups via validation as new protein classes arrive.
NLCWJnak81.evidence: Benchmarked across two enzyme function datasets (Enzyme Reaction and EC Number), five frozen protein encoders, and thirteen class-incremental learning baselines.
NLCWJnak81.claimed_gains: Achieves the highest average accuracy among compared baselines on both datasets, reaching 74.9% on Enzyme Reaction and 72.9% on EC Number.

g0JUpHHnNC.one_liner: Learns turn-boundary VLM KV-cache eviction via future-turn KL distillation, random-sketch complementarity, and minimum image-token quotas.
g0JUpHHnNC.problem: Multi-turn VLM KV caches grow continuously, while heuristic eviction drops low-attention image tokens that later dialogue turns still require.
g0JUpHHnNC.method: CarryKV applies a lightweight selector at turn boundaries combining Structure-Aware Encoding with Sketch-Conditioned Selection, which enforces a minimum image-token quota and picks entries complementary to a randomly retained cache sketch. The selector is trained via future-turn KL distillation against the full-cache frozen VLM and integrated into vLLM to physically free evicted memory blocks.
g0JUpHHnNC.key_idea: Train a turn-boundary KV-cache selector via next-turn KL distillation to retain an image-token quota plus entries complementary to a random cache sketch.
g0JUpHHnNC.evidence: Integrated into vLLM and evaluated on MMDU, MultiVerse, MMRC, and ConvBench using Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GLM-4.6V-Flash-9B.
g0JUpHHnNC.claimed_gains: Trains a single budget-reusable selector checkpoint on 100 dialogues in under 25 minutes on one A100 GPU; downstream benchmark metrics are truncated in the abstract.

QAHrNXcaob.one_liner: Benchmarks zero-shot 360-degree image and video understanding across bearing-dependent and bearing-invariant QA tasks alongside a training-free reasoning baseline.
QAHrNXcaob.problem: Existing panoramic benchmarks focus on static images and fail to isolate observer-bearing-dependent spatial reasoning across full 360-degree fields of view.
QAHrNXcaob.method: PanoArena compiles 4,631 question-answering samples spanning panoramic images and videos across over 10 subtasks explicitly partitioned into bearing-dependent and bearing-invariant settings. The authors also introduce PanoCompass, a training-free method designed to probe intrinsic panoramic reasoning without task-specific fine-tuning.
QAHrNXcaob.key_idea: Partition 360-degree image and video QA tasks into observer-bearing-dependent and bearing-invariant splits to test zero-shot panoramic spatial reasoning.
QAHrNXcaob.evidence: Zero-shot evaluation of multimodal large language models across multiple panoramic visual representations on 4,631 image and video QA samples spanning over 10 subtasks.

KbV1mu0JQ5.one_liner: Unifies dense/sparse video perception and conditional RGB synthesis inside one video transformer via shared attention and role-specific MLPs.
KbV1mu0JQ5.problem: Extracting accurate scene structure from video features does not ensure those same dense and sparse representations can control conditional video generation within one model.
KbV1mu0JQ5.method: WorldCeption adapts a pretrained video transformer with shared self-attention, role-dependent feed-forward networks, and task-specific attention masking to map bidirectionally between RGB video and both dense perceptual fields and sparse continuous or discrete states. Because both directions share an interface, estimated perceptual states can directly condition video synthesis or cross-representation translation.
KbV1mu0JQ5.key_idea: Share transformer attention across bidirectional video-to-state perception and state-to-video generation while specializing feed-forward pathways and information-access masks by role.
KbV1mu0JQ5.evidence: Experiments evaluating camera-state estimation, state-conditioned video reconstruction, camera-motion redirection, and composed perception-to-generation translation.

K8K25HCQlM.one_liner: Prevents compounding regressions in self-evolving multi-agent workflows by gating step-graph edits on recurring cross-task diagnoses and paired validation.
K8K25HCQlM.problem: Self-evolving multi-agent systems inherit every accepted workflow edit across subsequent tasks, allowing noisy or overfitted revisions to compound into severe performance regressions.
K8K25HCQlM.method: Keeping the base LLM frozen, EMAS maps execution diagnoses onto a structured Step graph, triggers bounded workflow edit proposals only when diagnoses recur across multiple tasks, and retains edits only if they pass paired validation on separate instances.
K8K25HCQlM.key_idea: Gate inherited edits to a multi-agent workflow graph by requiring recurring cross-task failure diagnoses and paired held-out instance validation.
K8K25HCQlM.evidence: Evaluated over two evolution epochs across four benchmarks and 20-step Game24 evolution trajectories using Kimi K2.6 and Qwen3.6-27B backbones.
K8K25HCQlM.claimed_gains: Improves task-weighted held-out accuracy across four benchmarks by 4.10 percentage points with Kimi K2.6 and 12.09 percentage points with Qwen3.6-27B, while removing multi-task triggering or paired validation increases cumulative Game24 regression on Qwen by 2.7× and 31.4×.

ZBLOlBsHON.one_liner: TARDIS progressively constructs global equiangular tight-frame anchors to align representations across federated clients at different continual-learning stages.
ZBLOlBsHON.problem: Clients progressing through tasks at different rates bias federated aggregation and distort accumulated knowledge.
ZBLOlBsHON.method: TARDIS formalizes temporal heterogeneity in federated continual learning and progressively expands a global Equiangular Tight Frame as knowledge grows. Shared geometric anchors maintain representation consistency across heterogeneous client learning states.
ZBLOlBsHON.key_idea: Expand a shared global equiangular tight frame to anchor client representations despite asynchronous task progression.
ZBLOlBsHON.evidence: Experiments on four continual-learning benchmarks compare representative federated continual-learning baselines under Task-IL and Class-IL settings.

vLYqKr4ynQ.one_liner: HinD separates teacher reasoning from hindsight-based assessment of whether the student can learn it.
vLYqKr4ynQ.problem: Strong teachers can provide reasoning that weaker students cannot absorb, while hindsight-based self-teachers rely on information unavailable at deployment.
vLYqKr4ynQ.method: HinD uses a strong external teacher to supply reasoning and the student's hindsight response to assess its learnability. Hindsight adds verified outcome information while keeping the student model and reasoning state fixed.
vLYqKr4ynQ.key_idea: Use an external teacher for new reasoning and the student's hindsight response to assess compatibility with the student's learning capacity.

clQEFQi2pF.one_liner: GAIT aligns hidden-state trajectories with successful responses and reweights step advantages using changes in geometric divergence.
clQEFQi2pF.problem: Sequence-level RLVR rewards assign coarse credit, while step-level supervision and branching Monte Carlo estimates are costly.
clQEFQi2pF.method: GAIT uses dynamic time warping to align each response with successful responses in its rollout group. It measures divergence in a low-dimensional hidden-state space and uses temporal changes to redistribute sequence-level advantage across steps.
clQEFQi2pF.key_idea: Reweight sequence-level advantage using temporal changes in hidden-state divergence from dynamically aligned successful response trajectories.

CjcfTtwzfF.one_liner: GroundPO internalizes privileged information in a teacher before on-policy distillation for reasoning-intensive visual grounding.
CjcfTtwzfF.problem: Privileged teachers can transfer privilege-specific artifacts and excessively long reasoning to students, causing training collapse in visual grounding.
CjcfTtwzfF.method: GroundPO first internalizes privileged information into the teacher policy while discouraging privilege leakage and excessive response length. It then distills that policy on-policy into a student without privileged inputs.
CjcfTtwzfF.key_idea: Absorb privileged information into a teacher policy before using that policy for on-policy student distillation.
CjcfTtwzfF.evidence: Experiments report reduced PrivShift and strong GroundPO-27B grounding performance, alongside DeepGround training data and a benchmark spanning five reasoning-intensive tracks.

nOqwlus0Nw.one_liner: CSPO calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds from recent training statistics to control tail exposure under policy drift.
nOqwlus0Nw.problem: Fixed GSPO clipping bounds produce changing fractions of clipped response scores as the policy evolves.
nOqwlus0Nw.method: CSPO adapts sequence-level clipping endpoints using recent statistics to target a specified marginal tail budget. It derives miscoverage bounds with CDF discrepancy and drift terms, plus objective and gradient error bounds under additional moment conditions.
nOqwlus0Nw.key_idea: Calibrate a sequence-level clipping band from recent score statistics to target marginal tail coverage as the policy changes.
nOqwlus0Nw.evidence: Miscoverage and moment-conditioned objective and gradient bounds accompany Qwen3-1.7B experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld against GSPO.

jDdt50MC3S.one_liner: JetSpec uses a causal parallel draft head over frozen target-model features to generate coupled speculative token distributions.
jDdt50MC3S.problem: Autoregressive drafting incurs depth-dependent cost, while branch-agnostic parallel drafting can produce inconsistent candidate trees with low acceptance.
jDdt50MC3S.method: JetSpec trains a causal parallel draft head on fused hidden states from a frozen target model. One forward pass couples draft distributions through causal information flow for tree speculative decoding.
jDdt50MC3S.key_idea: Generate causally coupled draft distributions in one forward pass using fused hidden states from the frozen target model.
jDdt50MC3S.evidence: Evaluations cover math, coding, and chat benchmarks using dense and MoE Qwen3 models.

4eG3tlpIOz.one_liner: AutoSupervision links reviewer concerns, author responses, and manuscript evidence to evaluate scientific revision verification.
4eG3tlpIOz.problem: AI-assisted scientific workflows lack evaluation of whether revisions meaningfully address reviewer concerns with manuscript evidence.
4eG3tlpIOz.method: AutoSupervision derives supervision from transparent peer-review records linking concerns, claimed resolutions, and revised manuscripts. Models characterize concerns, judge resolution, and locate supporting manuscript evidence.
4eG3tlpIOz.key_idea: Evaluate concern resolution by grounding author response claims in evidence from revised manuscripts.
4eG3tlpIOz.evidence: The benchmark contains 8,790 episode-level concerns from Nature Communications records and includes LLM experiments, an ablation, and a case study.
4eG3tlpIOz.claimed_gains: GPT-5.5 scores 0.754 on concern characterization, while the best-performing model reaches only 0.501 on evidence-based verification.

dot4tICbzQ.one_liner: Worst- and best-case classifier heads learn predictive credal sets from ambiguous annotation distributions.
dot4tICbzQ.problem: Collapsing ambiguous annotations into a single distribution obscures uncertainty left unresolved by the evidence.
dot4tICbzQ.method: POCC trains two heads over a shared backbone to minimize worst-case and best-case losses over credal supervision sets, using their outputs to define predictive uncertainty. A relaxation of probabilistic labels provides practical credal labels with closed-form inner cross-entropy optimization.
dot4tICbzQ.key_idea: Train pessimistic and optimistic heads against convex sets of plausible labels and use their output spread as predictive uncertainty.
dot4tICbzQ.evidence: A conditional finite-sample generalization bound quantifies supervision imprecision, and evaluations use human annotator disagreement and teacher predictions.

DtcFTuFW9v.one_liner: Visual attention rescales token advantages, and predictive entropy focuses policy gradients for multimodal hallucination mitigation.
DtcFTuFW9v.problem: Sequence-level RLVR advantages do not distinguish token contributions to weak visual grounding or uncertain reasoning errors.
DtcFTuFW9v.method: VIEW first rescales token advantages using visual-attention ratios as grounding proxies, then emphasizes high-entropy tokens in the policy gradient. Both signals are used only in training, leaving autoregressive inference unchanged.
DtcFTuFW9v.key_idea: Reweight token-level RL signals using visual-attention ratios and predictive entropy to distinguish grounding and reasoning uncertainty.
DtcFTuFW9v.evidence: Experiments evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B across hallucination, visual-reasoning, and general multimodal benchmarks.

0s3MROgN34.one_liner: Hypothesis verification directs video observations toward alternative events or denser temporal boundaries during grounding.
0s3MROgN34.problem: Fixed global video observations can lack the evidence needed to identify queried events and refine their temporal boundaries.
0s3MROgN34.method: VerifyGround proposes an interval, inspects its segment, and uses verification to choose between relocating the event and gathering denser boundary evidence. GroundStep-30K supports supervised initialization, followed by process-aware RL combining localization rewards with action-specific progress supervision.
0s3MROgN34.key_idea: Verify event identity and boundary support, then acquire alternative-region evidence or denser boundary observations according to the verification result.

FjfI6Xv5PO.one_liner: Disagreement between numerical and knowledge states selects perturbation experiments whose outcomes adjudicate virtual-cell corrections.
FjfI6Xv5PO.problem: Virtual cells must jointly preserve continuous prediction and explicit biological reasoning while deciding which states new experimental evidence should correct.
FjfI6Xv5PO.method: VCrectify maintains numerical predictive and explicit knowledge states, using their disagreement to acquire perturbation experiments. An evidence adjudicator determines which states to update, and the corrected states guide subsequent experiment selection.
FjfI6Xv5PO.key_idea: Use cross-state disagreement to acquire perturbation evidence, then adjudicate selective updates to numerical predictions and explicit biological knowledge.
FjfI6Xv5PO.evidence: Experiments across multiple virtual-cell backbones and perturbation datasets assess numerical prediction, directional reasoning, and generalization to unseen cellular contexts.

utyToIABTn.one_liner: Failure detection, robust value estimation, and positive-negative sub-policy composition reuse robot interactions for autonomous improvement.
utyToIABTn.problem: Real-world robot RL faces expensive interactions and supervision, sparse long-horizon rewards, and underused suboptimal rollouts.
utyToIABTn.method: DEC uses a dynamics-aware discriminator to trigger human takeover and resume autonomy, and estimates value through trajectory-held-out bootstrapping and discounted partial returns. It learns complementary positive and negative sub-policies from successful and suboptimal experience and composes them at inference.
utyToIABTn.key_idea: Combine failure-triggered intervention, held-out trajectory value estimation, and positive-negative sub-policy composition to learn from both successful and suboptimal rollouts.
utyToIABTn.evidence: Experiments cover simulated manipulation and long-horizon dexterous bimanual tasks in the real world with limited human intervention.

AU5kWGxCvC.one_liner: Sparse recombination of pretrained vision channels builds compact task-specific models from small calibration sets.
AU5kWGxCvC.problem: Distillation leaves student weights unconstrained, requiring substantial data and training to connect teacher representations to viable compact models.
AU5kWGxCvC.method: Channel-Remix treats a vision foundation model as both teacher and library of pretrained weight directions. Under a parameter budget, it retains core channels and sparsely mixes pruned channels into them to create task-adapted channels without inference overhead.
AU5kWGxCvC.key_idea: Construct student weights by retaining core pretrained channels and sparsely mixing pruned channels into them.
AU5kWGxCvC.evidence: Experiments span 16 tasks, 7 pretraining families, and 5 model sizes, with comparisons against LoRA-based distillation and pruned models.
AU5kWGxCvC.claimed_gains: Channel-Remix matches LoRA-based distillation using 3-4x less calibration data and improves pruned models by 4.6% on average.

jKaGpCYheS.one_liner: LLM-assisted tree search discovers personalized agent configurations that trigger harmful actions without explicit harmful instructions.
jKaGpCYheS.problem: Personalization files and installed skills can cause autonomous agents to execute unintended harmful actions.
jKaGpCYheS.method: CONTRA reasons about dangerous configurations and evaluates them through tree search in a simulated environment. SkillSafetyBench pairs popular skills with harmful actions, and virtual-machine tests check whether discovered vulnerabilities persist with real tools.
jKaGpCYheS.key_idea: Search agent configurations with an LLM-guided tree and simulated evaluations to identify settings that induce unintended harmful actions.
jKaGpCYheS.evidence: SkillSafetyBench contains the 532 most downloaded skills from a public repository and 1869 harmful actions, with virtual-machine validation under real tool execution.
jKaGpCYheS.claimed_gains: The analysis finds that 74.2% of skills have at least one configuration resulting in a harmful action.

JzPDBEz1rL.one_liner: Later full-computation feedback retrospectively corrects skipped diffusion steps, while variance reduction selects correction anchors.
JzPDBEz1rL.problem: Forward-only diffusion caching commits approximations that cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full evaluations.
JzPDBEz1rL.method: PoSTCache generates skipped-step proposals with an existing cache strategy, then propagates discrepancies from later refreshed predictions backward to refine and reintegrate earlier predictions. Its PVR strategy uses offline temporal dependencies to choose anchors by expected surrogate trajectory-uncertainty reduction.
JzPDBEz1rL.key_idea: Propagate later full-step prediction discrepancies backward to revise cached trajectory segments, choosing anchors by expected posterior variance reduction.

uTpxtRt2WG.one_liner: Separate semantic and spatial fMRI decoding branches combine through routing and functional alignment for multi-subject scene reconstruction.
uTpxtRt2WG.problem: Brain-to-scene decoding struggles with compositional scene structure, inter-subject functional variability, and evaluation misalignment with human perception.
uTpxtRt2WG.method: MindStrata decodes hierarchical semantics in CLIP-aligned space and spatial organization in latent layout space, combining them with a Brain-Scene Routing Controller. Subject-specific normalization and relational consistency address subject variability, while a semantic-faithfulness protocol evaluates reconstructed content.
uTpxtRt2WG.key_idea: Route stratified semantic and spatial fMRI representations into scene reconstruction while aligning subjects through normalization and relational consistency.

54gJFOGVhv.one_liner: Quadtree tokens allocate detail by region and supply a causal topology for autoregressive image generation.
54gJFOGVhv.problem: Fixed grids and flat token sequences do not jointly provide spatial binding, flexible token allocation, and adaptive regional detail.
54gJFOGVhv.method: QuadTok encodes intricate regions with finer quadtree branches and homogeneous regions coarsely. A GPT-style generator follows a supplied quadtree topology, which also provides coarse spatial control over detail placement.
54gJFOGVhv.key_idea: Represent images with adaptive quadtree tokens and condition autoregressive generation on the tree topology.
54gJFOGVhv.evidence: An ImageNet-trained tokenizer is evaluated on ImageNet and zero-shot COCO, while a 947M GPT-style generator is tested on ImageNet 256 × 256.
54gJFOGVhv.claimed_gains: Against a fixed 256-token grid, QuadTok saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% on zero-shot COCO with comparable reconstruction fidelity, and its generator achieves 2.08 gFID on ImageNet 256 × 256.

XbUL33Dbeo.one_liner: A separate controller guides a fixed coding worker across benchmark settings that isolate runtime task-management decisions.
XbUL33Dbeo.problem: End-to-end coding outcomes confound a controller's guidance with the worker agent's execution ability.
XbUL33Dbeo.method: LoopArena presents a Controller with structured summaries after coding rounds and asks it to direct a fixed Worker or stop. Three settings vary execution scope and cost, including static control questions and selected task slices.
XbUL33Dbeo.key_idea: Hold the coding Worker fixed while evaluating a Controller's next-step, verification, and stopping decisions from structured run summaries.
XbUL33Dbeo.evidence: The benchmark includes 160 low-cost four-way control questions and 80 selected task slices; the supplied abstract truncates the third setting's description.

VocOWh2KXS.one_liner: Contrastive action likelihoods train skillbank edits alongside an evolving actor without new rollouts for each proposal.
VocOWh2KXS.problem: Skill-reuse rewards can conflate skill benefits with actor improvement, while directly evaluating each proposal requires costly rollouts.
VocOWh2KXS.method: UniSkill shares a policy between environment interaction and skillbank edits, training the actor with environment rewards. Skill proposals receive feedback from their effect on successful-versus-failed action log-likelihood gaps in existing trajectories, with edit-support regularization preserving exploration.
VocOWh2KXS.key_idea: Score proposed skill replacements by changes in the current actor's successful-versus-failed action log-likelihood gap on previously collected trajectories.
VocOWh2KXS.evidence: The abstract reports an ALFWorld evaluation of the jointly evolving actor and skill proposer.

cpL8n2f1Hn.one_liner: Competition-aware class rewards and reward-guided feature regularization fine-tune point-cloud segmentation predictions.
cpL8n2f1Hn.problem: Feature-geometry and output-distribution surrogate objectives do not consistently improve segmentation accuracy or address imbalanced class competition.
cpL8n2f1Hn.method: PointCRO uses Class-Group Relative Optimization to rebalance competition among the correct class, strongest incorrect class, and remaining classes. Reward-guided feature-level KL regularization transfers those preferences into pairwise feature relations.
cpL8n2f1Hn.key_idea: Rebalance point-wise correct-versus-incorrect class competition with relative rewards, then align pairwise feature relations with those reward-induced preferences.
cpL8n2f1Hn.evidence: Experiments across multiple unnamed benchmarks report consistent semantic-segmentation improvements.

RaiGFEqfen.one_liner: Semantic visual primitives bind geometry, properties, and action cues into verified evidence graphs for recognition and manipulation.
RaiGFEqfen.problem: Multimodal models can describe visual details without faithfully grounding them or using them as structured evidence for decisions.
RaiGFEqfen.method: SVP-R constructs primitives linking part location, semantic properties, and action support into an evidence graph. Graph-binding objectives verify nodes, edges, and the whole graph through recognition-specific and manipulation-specific formulations.
RaiGFEqfen.key_idea: Bind spatial, semantic, and action cues into an evidence graph and supervise consistency at node, edge, and graph levels.
RaiGFEqfen.evidence: Recognition and manipulation experiments compare grounded-reasoning and VLA methods, while interventions test whether decisions follow grounded evidence.

QqYo1LtowJ.one_liner: 3D reconstruction priors guide autoregressive video diffusion to render upper-body avatars with stable structure and dynamic detail.
QqYo1LtowJ.problem: One-shot avatar reconstruction suffers from blurry textures and stiff motion, while video generation can introduce structural errors and identity drift.
QqYo1LtowJ.method: ViSA uses a 3D reconstruction model to provide structural and appearance priors for a real-time autoregressive video diffusion renderer. This couples reconstruction geometry with video synthesis of fine details and motion.
QqYo1LtowJ.key_idea: Condition an autoregressive video diffusion renderer on structural and appearance priors supplied by a 3D reconstruction model.
QqYo1LtowJ.evidence: The abstract reports avatar-generation experiments demonstrating fewer artifacts but supplies no named datasets or evaluation settings.

ceDyzYWJuu.one_liner: Hessian-based analysis explains why unions of exact separately distilled datasets can fail to reproduce joint-data training.
ceDyzYWJuu.problem: Individually exact dataset distillates need not compose into an exact distillate of the combined real data.
ceDyzYWJuu.method: The paper derives exact composition error for two-to-one trajectory compression on quadratic objectives using source-Hessian variance and linear loss terms. It relates this error to local smooth-network discrepancies and studies displaced optima and learned synthetic-set composition.
ceDyzYWJuu.key_idea: Analyze how nonlinear trajectory compression makes averaging compressed source statistics differ from compressing their average.
ceDyzYWJuu.evidence: Quadratic theory is examined through smooth-network endpoint discrepancies, a label-skewed linear probe, and ConvNet source-map composition.
ceDyzYWJuu.claimed_gains: Under label skew, composition costs a linear probe up to nine accuracy points and a ConvNet six to ten points at a compression ratio of 512.

lINFf9AA6A.one_liner: Pose-informed view extrapolation converts heterogeneous long-tail driving videos into temporally coherent multi-view policy-training data.
lINFf9AA6A.problem: Rare driving events captured by heterogeneous monocular sources lack the views and camera information required by policy-training pipelines.
lINFf9AA6A.method: OpenLongTail synthesizes missing views using pose-informed extrapolation. Plücker-ray camera conditioning and lane-weighted supervision guide geometric consistency and emphasize sparse lane structures.
lINFf9AA6A.key_idea: Synthesize missing driving views with pose and Plücker-ray conditioning, emphasizing lane structure through weighted supervision.
lINFf9AA6A.evidence: The abstract reports improved closed-loop driving robustness on long-tail events using synthesized heterogeneous data.

JgGgheRnzj.one_liner: Specialized-domain video grounding benchmarks pair dense spatio-temporal annotations with limited training subsets to evaluate adaptation.
JgGgheRnzj.problem: Zero-shot evaluation on everyday scenes does not measure video-grounding adaptation to rare concepts in specialized domains.
JgGgheRnzj.method: AnyGroundBench combines expert-annotated new videos and established datasets across animal, industry, sports, surgery, and public-security domains. Dense annotations and dedicated limited training subsets support comparisons of zero-shot generalization and adaptation methods.
JgGgheRnzj.key_idea: Evaluate spatio-temporal grounding across specialized domains using unified dense annotations and controlled limited-data adaptation subsets.
JgGgheRnzj.evidence: The benchmark evaluates 25 VLMs zero-shot and five training-free or fine-tuning adaptation strategies on representative models across five domains.

tgWVZQhZpa.one_liner: IMU-guided keyframe selection and motion-token fusion ground video representations in metric scale and cross-view geometry.
tgWVZQhZpa.problem: Video-based spatial reasoning lacks physical scale grounding, while explicit 3D representations impose substantial computation costs.
tgWVZQhZpa.method: Motion-MLLM selects sparse keyframes using cascaded motion and visual filtering. Asymmetric cross-modal fusion uses motion tokens to convey concurrent IMU trajectories and cross-frame visual context into visual representations.
tgWVZQhZpa.key_idea: Use concurrent IMU motion to select keyframes and mediate cross-frame visual fusion through motion tokens.
tgWVZQhZpa.evidence: Experiments cover 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning, comparing methods using video frames and explicit 3D data.

hj0TMJW3sk.one_liner: Cached blank-image patch tokens restore background cross-attention structure for 3D generation from arbitrary image references.
hj0TMJW3sk.problem: Image-conditioned 3D generators expect object-centric references and can distort or fragment geometry when given full-frame textures, scenes, or artwork.
hj0TMJW3sk.method: Backdrop appends cached patch tokens from one blank image to the reference condition. This restores the background-token population expected by deeper generator blocks without retraining or per-instance optimization.
hj0TMJW3sk.key_idea: Append blank-image patch tokens to reference conditioning to restore the background-token population that absorbs deeper-layer cross-attention.
hj0TMJW3sk.evidence: Token-removal and restoration interventions support the mechanism, and TRELLIS.2 experiments span textures, scenes, artistic images, and multiple stylization methods.

Fbwzk67KqW.one_liner: An external judge updates team social states, and trajectory-guided persona recasting addresses collaborative agent failures.
Fbwzk67KqW.problem: LLM teams can suppress relevant information, follow dominant wrong answers, and fail to sanction norm violations.
Fbwzk67KqW.method: Agent Sociodrama uses an external LLM judge to update emotional states and directed relationships each round under fixed personas. TPR diagnoses failures from transcripts and social trajectories, recasts personas, and reruns tasks.
Fbwzk67KqW.key_idea: Track evolving emotional and relational states, then use those trajectories to diagnose group failures and recast agent personas.
Fbwzk67KqW.evidence: Social fidelity is assessed across six LLM backbones and five scenarios against theory and human judgments, while TPR is evaluated on four collaborative benchmarks.
Fbwzk67KqW.claimed_gains: TPR yields up to 83.3%p accuracy improvement over initial casting and outperforms SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate.

xAqEnOxVgr.one_liner: Pre-inference conflict graphs coordinate transaction protection and GPU admission for concurrent agents sharing workspace state.
xAqEnOxVgr.problem: Optimistic conflict checks waste completed inference, while pessimistic locking suppresses useful concurrency during prolonged agent computation.
xAqEnOxVgr.method: AtxServe builds a conflict graph before main inference, orders conflicting requests, and jointly admits compatible ones. Admitted requests validate planning reads when binding snapshots, with dependency protection extending through commit.
xAqEnOxVgr.key_idea: Schedule compatible agent transactions together before inference using a conflict graph, then protect validated planning and execution dependencies through commit.
xAqEnOxVgr.evidence: The abstract introduces RMWBench for evaluation but truncates its description and results.

AaFzQywGv7.one_liner: Session-based streaming clinical trajectories and physician-validated memory test long-horizon multimodal medical agents.
AaFzQywGv7.problem: Existing medical-memory benchmarks cover too few modalities and tasks to capture evolving multimodal clinical information.
AaFzQywGv7.method: MedMME divides clinical dialogue and procedure-video trajectories into sessions under a streaming input protocol. Physician-validated clinical memory supports evaluation of memory extraction, updating, and retrieval.
AaFzQywGv7.key_idea: Stream sessionized multimodal clinical trajectories and evaluate memory extraction, updating, and retrieval against physician-validated clinical memory.
AaFzQywGv7.evidence: The benchmark spans 10 clinical domains and 9 visual modalities, evaluating 19 multimodal agents built on nine memory mechanisms.

7Cal4rJXWF.one_liner: Metric-level pilot predictions compose into joint allocation states before nonlinear utility assigns candidate data value.
7Cal4rJXWF.problem: Independent scalar-gain estimates miss how nonlinear task utility changes a domain's marginal value as other domains receive data.
7Cal4rJXWF.method: CTS fits per-metric responses to added data from fixed single-domain pilots and additively composes predicted changes across domains. It then applies task utility to the joint metric state to revalue candidate additions without additional pilot training.
7Cal4rJXWF.key_idea: Compose predicted metric changes across domains into a joint state before applying nonlinear task utility to value candidate additions.
7Cal4rJXWF.evidence: Autonomous-driving and satellite-classification experiments compare seven baselines, with matched ablations and controlled retraining testing joint-state valuation.
7Cal4rJXWF.claimed_gains: At matched budgets, CTS improves composite driving score by 0.71–1.61 points and worst-region accuracy by 0.93–3.21 percentage points over the strongest of seven baselines.

r2MXRcI9D4.one_liner: Random-pairing fluctuations calibrate cross-modal coupling reliability for multimodal dataset distillation.
r2MXRcI9D4.problem: Mini-batch coupling estimates vary with batch composition, weakening preservation of dataset-level multimodal structure in synthetic data.
r2MXRcI9D4.method: ReCoup calibrates encoder-space couplings using fluctuations from random image-text pairings and weights more reproducible couplings more heavily. An auxiliary constraint preserves diagonal coupling profiles in the projected shared space.
r2MXRcI9D4.key_idea: Weight cross-modal coupling matches by reliability inferred from random-pairing fluctuations while constraining projected diagonal coupling profiles.
r2MXRcI9D4.evidence: Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO compare multimodal distillation methods across synthetic-set budgets.
r2MXRcI9D4.claimed_gains: With 500 synthetic pairs, ReCoup improves mean Recall by 7.3 points on Flickr30K and 5.1 points on MS-COCO.

9hmXuJRTzA.one_liner: Question-driven routing blends specialized audio experts, with progressive focus augmentation guiding increasingly abstract audio reasoning.
9hmXuJRTzA.problem: A single entangled audio representation encourages language models to overuse text cues and neglect task-relevant audio aspects.
9hmXuJRTzA.method: FAME trains five audio-aspect expert heads and a question-conditioned soft mixture-of-experts router through a three-stage curriculum. Focus augmentation names relevant experts, adds an auxiliary correctness objective, and later extends attention to abstract concepts.
9hmXuJRTzA.key_idea: Route question-conditioned audio evidence across specialized aspect experts and progressively augment questions to direct expert-level and abstract focus.

sVDtEVL2Bs.one_liner: NeuralCP tags LoRA-induced functional changes, validates them through replay, and distills selected knowledge into the backbone.
sVDtEVL2Bs.problem: Continual learning must consolidate new knowledge without destructively overwriting previously learned representations.
sVDtEVL2Bs.method: NeuralCP learns task-specific knowledge in a lightweight LoRA module and uses function-space attribution to tag important representation changes. A small calibration set validates tags before residual distillation consolidates them through stable-plastic subspaces.
sVDtEVL2Bs.key_idea: Validate functionally attributed memory tags through replay, then distill selected updates into stable-plastic backbone subspaces.
sVDtEVL2Bs.claimed_gains: NeuralCP introduces zero additional parameters or overhead at inference.

jymjHHAWbX.one_liner: Camera-time adaptation, hierarchical feature consolidation, and corrective Gaussian decoding reconstruct dynamic driving scenes from sparse observations.
jymjHHAWbX.problem: Sparse multi-camera temporal observations provide uneven geometric support and make coherent dynamic-scene reconstruction difficult.
jymjHHAWbX.method: SOM4D models camera-time relations within a frozen visual-geometry backbone and consolidates multilevel features with shared scene context. A corrective Gaussian head refines dynamic Gaussians using geometry-aware correction and recurrent source-render feedback, complemented by heterogeneous training.
jymjHHAWbX.key_idea: Organize sparse observations by camera-time relations and refine decoded dynamic Gaussians through geometry-aware correction and recurrent rendering feedback.
jymjHHAWbX.evidence: The paper analyzes geometric support across cameras and time and assesses heterogeneous mixed-data training on Waymo.

1dnMPSRd38.one_liner: Per-product evidence inspection produces condition-level profiles that a decision agent compares for multi-condition product retrieval.
1dnMPSRd38.problem: Semantic relevance scores cannot reliably enforce complex shopping requirements across specifications, compatibility, price, appearance, and reviews.
1dnMPSRd38.method: PDeepSearch retrieves and reranks candidates, then PInspect builds condition-level evidence profiles and PDecide compares them to select a product. PDeepSearch-9B learns from synthesized inspection and decision trajectories.
1dnMPSRd38.key_idea: Inspect each candidate for supporting, uncertain, and contradictory evidence per condition, then compare candidate profiles to select a product.
1dnMPSRd38.evidence: Product Deep Search evaluates API-based and open-weight backbones and a trained 9B agent, including comparison with Qwen3.5-27B.
1dnMPSRd38.claimed_gains: The framework improves zero-shot backbones by 2.43–7.29 Hit@1 points, and PDeepSearch-9B achieves 69.43 Hit@1 versus Qwen3.5-27B's 63.71.

OE6Inemyae.one_liner: Recurrent language-conditioned scene memory and localized object queries support referring-expression segmentation from streaming RGB observations.
OE6Inemyae.problem: Offline 3D segmentation cannot directly handle incremental scene reconstruction or targets that leave and re-enter an embodied agent's view.
OE6Inemyae.method: Ground3R jointly reconstructs scenes and segments language-referred objects using only current and past RGB images. Its multimodal memory maintains a language-conditioned scene state, while a spatial query module generates language-independent object proposals.
OE6Inemyae.key_idea: Maintain language-conditioned scene memory across frames and combine it with spatially localized object queries for incremental target segmentation.

ooV5M72O08.one_liner: Reserved-token value scores select among a language model's own proposals during post-training.
ooV5M72O08.problem: The paper asks whether consequential post-training decisions introduce new candidates or reorder candidates already ranked highly by pretraining.
ooV5M72O08.method: ProQ keeps standard-token logits for reasoning and candidate proposal, regularized toward the pretrained model. It repurposes reserved-token logits into candidate-conditioned value scores for reinforcement-learning-based local selection.
ooV5M72O08.key_idea: Use reserved-token logits to score candidates proposed by standard-token logits, which remain regularized toward the pretrained model.
ooV5M72O08.evidence: Analysis spans 31 model–task–checkpoint settings, including successful post-training-induced prefixes absent from pretrained-policy trajectories; ProQ trains on mathematical reasoning.
ooV5M72O08.claimed_gains: Across 31 settings, 92.9% of post-training Top-1 changes remain within the pretrained Top-16 on average.

OQLklELUmg.one_liner: Separate camera and time encodings alternate cross-camera and temporal attention for multi-camera 4D reconstruction.
OQLklELUmg.problem: Flattening synchronized observations or processing cameras independently fails to explicitly model cross-camera geometry and temporal correspondence.
OQLklELUmg.method: CxT4D separates camera and temporal identities and alternates attention across synchronized cameras and individual camera streams. RoboCT4D standardizes evaluation, and a Long-Sequence MV4D Strategy reduces inference memory.
OQLklELUmg.key_idea: Encode camera and temporal identities separately, alternating attention across synchronized camera views and along each camera's temporal stream.
OQLklELUmg.evidence: Experiments on four RoboCT4D subsets cover simulated and real robot manipulation datasets and evaluate depth, cross-camera rotation, and memory use.
OQLklELUmg.claimed_gains: Long-sequence inference reduces peak memory by 51.0% at eight timestamps and 60.3% at twelve timestamps.

QmqnmbGnSn.one_liner: Human-video prompts condition a causal video-action model, while future-chunk prediction forces task information to come from the prompt.
QmqnmbGnSn.problem: Robot policies struggle to execute manipulation tasks unseen during training, and task-rich paired human–robot data are scarce.
QmqnmbGnSn.method: Zero-WAM follows in-context human videos with a causal video-action model trained using an in-context future chunk prediction objective. An automatic pipeline converts robot trajectories into matched human videos to build HumanGen.
QmqnmbGnSn.key_idea: Condition causal video-action prediction on human demonstrations and use future-chunk prediction to suppress shortcuts from previously seen tasks.
QmqnmbGnSn.evidence: HumanGen contains 74.2K human–robot pairs across 8.6K tasks, and evaluation covers seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 simulation tasks.
QmqnmbGnSn.claimed_gains: Zero-WAM achieves a 47.0% average success rate, with a reported absolute improvement of 29.5 percentage points.

I91ZBFh5tv.one_liner: Behavior taxonomies guide executable task synthesis and allocate additional training data according to per-behavior failure rates.
I91ZBFh5tv.problem: Scenario diversity in synthetic tool-use data can repeatedly exercise the same behaviors while leaving others underrepresented.
I91ZBFh5tv.method: BehaviorPilot induces a hierarchical behavior taxonomy from open-source trajectories and generates verified tasks targeting selected behavior combinations. It allocates further synthesis budget according to failures on a fixed, behavior-balanced validation set.
I91ZBFh5tv.key_idea: Condition task generation on behavior combinations, verify behavior coverage, and allocate subsequent synthesis budget in proportion to per-behavior failure rates.
I91ZBFh5tv.evidence: Qwen3-8B experiments include VitaBench and BFCL V4 multi-turn, with the remaining benchmark list truncated in the supplied abstract.

NS8wMDkYDW.one_liner: Token-conditioned keys and values decoded from Mamba-2 chunk states enable attention retrieval over recurrent memory.
NS8wMDkYDW.problem: Layer-level hybrids leave unresolved whether one memory representation can support recurrent compression and attention-style retrieval.
NS8wMDkYDW.method: DART retains Mamba-2 chunk state contributions as memories and decodes token-conditioned keys and values for state-memory attention. A gated residual combines retrieved information with native Mamba-2 output, using reused SSD computation and FlashAttention-style attention.
NS8wMDkYDW.key_idea: Decode token-conditioned keys and values from recurrent chunk states, attend over them, and gate the retrieval into native Mamba-2 output.
NS8wMDkYDW.evidence: The abstract derives the design from Mamba-2's state space duality and mentions analysis and experiments without supplying results.

CPt402f13m.one_liner: A globally informed teacher distills coordinated action distributions into robot policies conditioned only on local observations.
CPt402f13m.problem: Robots with only local observations struggle to infer partners' intentions and coordinate manipulation.
CPt402f13m.method: A centralized teacher learns coordinated behaviors from global observations and distills its action distribution into locally conditioned students. At deployment, each robot acts independently without partner observations, states, or actions.
CPt402f13m.key_idea: Distill a centralized teacher's action distribution into local-observation student policies during training, then execute each student independently.
CPt402f13m.evidence: Experiments on RoboFactory and real-world multi-robot tasks compare against centralized baselines and prior decentralized methods.

jUUDfdBcxb.one_liner: Retrieved experiences become learnable latent teacher context for dense supervision of a student's on-policy trajectories.
jUUDfdBcxb.problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation depends on designer-specified privileged artifacts, limiting end-to-end learning from experience.
jUUDfdBcxb.method: LOPD retrieves relevant experiences and composes continuous latent tokens that condition a self-teacher supervising student-generated trajectories at every visited prefix. A privileged-margin objective stabilizes and regulates latent-context learning.
jUUDfdBcxb.key_idea: Learn continuous privileged-context tokens from retrieved experiences and use the conditioned self-teacher to supervise student trajectories token by token.
jUUDfdBcxb.evidence: Experiments compare LOPD with RLVR, OPSD, SDPO, and Skill-SD on agentic tool use and code generation.

CqhUnamtX9.one_liner: Frozen event memories preserve identity references, while identity-aware attention losses separate characters during streaming video generation.
CqhUnamtX9.problem: Streaming video generators lose early identity anchors and produce identity fusion or duplication when attention overlaps or fragments.
CqhUnamtX9.method: MemID compresses each prompt-conditioned event into representative frames, freezes completed-event memories, and retrieves prompt-relevant entries. Identity-aware attention losses separate characters and encourage compact, temporally coherent attention within each identity.
CqhUnamtX9.key_idea: Freeze representative-frame memories after each event and train attention to separate identities while maintaining compact, temporally consistent regions.
CqhUnamtX9.evidence: The abstract reports experiments on long-range identity consistency and instance counts in multi-character narratives without naming datasets or models.

18V9RgM7x3.one_liner: Multimodal agents refine an editable diagram program into narrated animations using critic feedback.
18V9RgM7x3.problem: Static scientific diagrams poorly convey process dynamics, while manually producing animated explanations is time-consuming.
18V9RgM7x3.method: AnimateBanana converts a process diagram and requested style into an editable, animation-aware programmatic representation. Specialized multimodal agents plan presentation, narration, and animation, refining intermediate outputs through critic feedback.
18V9RgM7x3.key_idea: Build an animation-aware diagram program, then use specialized agents and critic feedback to refine presentation structure, narration, and animation.
18V9RgM7x3.evidence: AnimateBench contains 5000 process-oriented diagrams with verified animated narratives, expert-derived references where available, and task-specific evaluation metrics.

D7ukamunwM.one_liner: History-deletion counterfactuals define ranking-margin targets, while asymmetric gradients adjust competing items without editing inference inputs.
D7ukamunwM.problem: Misleading history can override current recommendation requests, and raising the target score alone may also raise competitors more.
D7ukamunwM.method: AIMS uses a frozen reference model to find history deletions that improve target scores and margins for already-correct requests. Training retains complete histories and combines cross-entropy with a margin-shortfall loss whose gradient affects only competitor scores.
D7ukamunwM.key_idea: Derive margin targets from helpful history deletions and penalize margin shortfalls through competitor-score gradients while retaining complete input histories.
D7ukamunwM.evidence: The supplied abstract mentions six LLM backbones on an industrial dataset but truncates before reporting results.

DzMH6XQN1a.one_liner: Exponential gradient smoothing precedes preference-anchored weighting to balance multiple diffusion reinforcement-learning rewards.
DzMH6XQN1a.problem: Noisy reward gradients and imbalanced MGDA weights make multi-objective diffusion reinforcement learning unreliable and leave some rewards under-optimized.
DzMH6XQN1a.method: Smooth Then Balance first smooths each reward gradient with an exponential moving average. It then combines the smoothed gradients using a preference anchor that guarantees a minimum weight for every reward.
DzMH6XQN1a.key_idea: Smooth reward gradients before computing multi-objective weights, then anchor those weights to ensure every reward receives a minimum contribution.
DzMH6XQN1a.evidence: Theory bounds direction error by gradient-estimation error and relates small updates to proximity to Pareto stationarity when estimation error is small.

36VxvilZPq.one_liner: Matched 3D escape-room tasks vary mechanism information and evidence access to diagnose embodied causal reasoning.
36VxvilZPq.problem: Embodied tasks confound failures to discover action–effect mechanisms with failures to acquire and integrate evidence.
36VxvilZPq.method: EmbodiedCausalEscape separates Association tasks with observable relations from Intervention tasks requiring action-based mechanism discovery. Matched diagnostic conditions preserve task logic while varying mechanism information, spatial evidence access, and irrelevant interactions.
36VxvilZPq.key_idea: Hold logical task instances fixed while manipulating access to mechanism structure, spatial evidence, and irrelevant interactions.
36VxvilZPq.evidence: Evaluation compares four vision-language agents with a human reference and tests mechanism-information and spatial-compaction interventions on GPT-5.5.
36VxvilZPq.claimed_gains: Main-condition success ranges from 1/30 to 9/30 versus 25/30 for humans; GPT-5.5 improves from 4/15 to 14/15 on Intervention tasks with mechanism structure and from 9/30 to 27/30 overall with spatial compaction.

FIpctuE7GT.one_liner: Coordinated watermark injection and bit-wise waveform–spectral expert selection protect speech identifiers against learned reconstruction.
FIpctuE7GT.problem: Learned speech transformations affect watermark carriers differently, so a single carrier cannot reliably preserve provenance across reconstruction models.
FIpctuE7GT.method: Thrive embeds multi-bit identifiers in discrete-token and continuous-representation autoregressive TTS. Rise coordinates intermediate watermark injection with subsequent generation, while Care selects waveform and spectral experts by bit-wise reliability.
FIpctuE7GT.key_idea: Synchronize intermediate watermark injection with continued generation and select waveform or spectral evidence separately for each recovered bit.
FIpctuE7GT.evidence: Experiments cover discrete-token and continuous-representation autoregressive TTS under reconstruction attacks and assess synthesis fidelity and watermark recovery.
FIpctuE7GT.claimed_gains: Thrive achieves 87.6% average recovery accuracy under reconstruction attacks while preserving synthesis fidelity.

kCX4PotiVu.one_liner: Mixed-index retrieval tests reveal when aligned source embeddings fail to retrieve alongside native target embeddings.
kCX4PotiVu.problem: Embedding alignment accuracy can conceal failures to retrieve translated documents in indexes containing embeddings from different models.
kCX4PotiVu.method: ETBench evaluates maps learned from documents encoded by both source and target models, then tests translated source-only documents alongside native target embeddings. The paper also derives a necessary and sufficient condition for preserving the target model's top-k set.
kCX4PotiVu.key_idea: Evaluate translated and native embeddings jointly in one retrieval index, explicitly checking retrieval of documents available only through source embeddings.
kCX4PotiVu.evidence: Theoretical analysis characterizes top-k preservation, and experiments evaluate alignment methods across 24 directed encoder pairs and four corpora.

2Gy7G3WFnG.one_liner: Authors and edits 3D scenes incrementally through Architect, Sculptor, and Inspector agents grounded in structured three-tier memory.
2Gy7G3WFnG.problem: Text-driven 3D scene generators lack requirement-level state tracking and local editability, forcing full-scene regeneration or manual fixes when part-level edits fail or alter non-target content.
2Gy7G3WFnG.method: MUSE formulates 3D scene construction and editing as incremental requirement satisfaction across three agents: an Architect compiling instructions into structured requirements, a Sculptor executing local scene operations, and an Inspector verifying outcomes while updating Working, Scene, and Skill Memory.
2Gy7G3WFnG.key_idea: Compile instructions into structured requirements via an Architect, apply local scene operations via a Sculptor, and verify each step via an Inspector updating Working, Scene, and Skill Memory.
2Gy7G3WFnG.evidence: Evaluated on the newly introduced AuthorBench benchmark comprising 145 constrained scene-construction cases and a 1,584-case editing pool (including a stratified 240-case editing split) with external structured checks.
2Gy7G3WFnG.claimed_gains: Improves AuthorBench construction All-Goal success from 37.9% to 80.7% (and from 80.0% to 87.6% without surface checks) over the strongest same-backend baseline, and reaches 76.7% All-Goal success with a 99.9% preservation rate on the 240-case editing split.

jjrK2b3xUW.one_liner: Forecasts downstream 3D-CT vision-language fine-tuning rankings across candidate encoders using inexpensive representation probes.
jjrK2b3xUW.problem: Selecting a 3D-CT image encoder for medical vision-language models typically requires training and evaluating full multimodal models for every candidate encoder at high computational cost.
jjrK2b3xUW.method: CheapCT evaluates frozen 3D-CT encoder representations using lightweight probes across multiple probe readouts and LLM backbones on clinical report generation and a new capability-specific VQA benchmark derived from segmentation masks and Hounsfield units to shortlist encoders before full fine-tuning.
jjrK2b3xUW.key_idea: Evaluate frozen 3D-CT image encoders with lightweight representation probes across clinical VQA and report-generation readouts to rank candidate encoders before full multimodal fine-tuning.
jjrK2b3xUW.evidence: Evaluated across multiple probe readouts, LLM backbones, and nine encoder configurations with Llama-3.1-8B on CT-RATE report generation (including CE-F1) and the new capability-level 3D-CT VQA dataset.
jjrK2b3xUW.claimed_gains: Achieves rank agreement rho = 0.90 to 0.97 between CheapCT and fine-tuning across the nine original CT-RATE configurations with Llama-3.1-8B.

spzlqUcaP2.one_liner: Detects AI-generated images via feature-space displacements under ANOVA-selected controlled perturbations in a frozen visual foundation model.
spzlqUcaP2.problem: AI-generated image detectors that rely directly on static image appearance features vary across scene semantics, limiting generalization to unseen domains.
spzlqUcaP2.method: Carrier-Perturbation Responses (CPR) treats each image as a carrier and measures authenticity from the feature-space displacement between the original and a controlled-perturbation image inside a frozen visual foundation model. An ANOVA-inspired selection criterion chooses perturbations with strong carrier-perturbation interaction, low rule-induced shift, and sufficient response magnitude.
spzlqUcaP2.key_idea: Measure authenticity from frozen-backbone feature displacements between original and perturbed images using perturbations selected via an ANOVA criterion for strong carrier-perturbation interaction and low rule-induced shift.
spzlqUcaP2.evidence: Supported by preliminary observations of perturbation-induced feature-change distributions on real and generated images in a frozen visual foundation model; specific evaluation datasets are not stated.

WHvKO06iw4.one_liner: Pairs 600 prompts with specialized vision models extracting object-level physical measurements to evaluate video generation across 46 dimensions.
