WHvKO06iw4.problem: Existing video generation benchmarks rely on coarse visual-language model judgments or target embodied world models rather than quantitatively measuring physical plausibility in generated videos.
WHvKO06iw4.method: PVBench evaluates generated videos across 46 dimensions in seven domains using 600 prompts, 30% of which involve physical embodied agents. Specialized vision models extract verifiable physical measurements including object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and numerical conservation-law residuals.
WHvKO06iw4.key_idea: Uses specialized vision models to extract verifiable object-level 6D pose, metric scale, surface normals, kinematics, and conservation-law residuals across 46 physical video dimensions.
WHvKO06iw4.evidence: Constructs a 600-prompt benchmark across 46 dimensions and seven domains covering text-to-video generation and embodied agents such as robot arms, humanoids, quadrupeds, and multi-agent systems.

odskMYTUBZ.one_liner: Enforces scale-separating architectural restrictions and multivariate prior gauge fixing to make Deep Evidential Regression parameters identifiable.
odskMYTUBZ.problem: Different evidential parameters in Deep Evidential Regression can induce the exact same Student-t predictive distribution while reporting conflicting evidence strengths and epistemic uncertainty.
odskMYTUBZ.method: The authors establish identifiability conditions for scalar affine softplus evidential heads on fixed features and extend them to multivariate regression via gauge fixing that decomposes the prior scale matrix into a normalized shape and a scalar amplitude. Structured evidential heads satisfying these scale-separation conditions remove predictive parameter ambiguity.
odskMYTUBZ.key_idea: Eliminates positive constant-multiple scale ambiguities in evidential heads and decomposes multivariate prior scale matrices into an identifiable normalized shape plus a scalar amplitude.
odskMYTUBZ.evidence: Supported by identifiability proofs and experiments on CIFAR-rotation, UCI regression tasks, synthetic data with known parameters, and a matched scale-multiplier control.
odskMYTUBZ.claimed_gains: Reduces cross-seed variation in evidence strength to four to seven times lower than unregularized DER on CIFAR-rotation at similar predictive log-likelihood.

RAVYLXJ1Ex.one_liner: Separates private mutable state capsules from shared initialized application runtimes for parallel computer-use reinforcement learning rollouts.
RAVYLXJ1Ex.problem: Conventional computer-use reinforcement learning deployments replicate an initialized application runtime for every parallel rollout, incurring repeated memory, storage, and startup overhead.
RAVYLXJ1Ex.method: CUA-Sandbox decouples per-trajectory private mutable state capsules from shared initialized application runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations including resets and branches, while retaining original software interfaces and task evaluators.
RAVYLXJ1Ex.key_idea: Isolates per-rollout mutable state into private capsules with transactional resets and branches while reusing shared initialized application runtimes across concurrent environments.
RAVYLXJ1Ex.evidence: Evaluated relative to Docker on task success, rollout throughput, per-environment memory, and incremental storage for computer-use reinforcement learning environments.
RAVYLXJ1Ex.claimed_gains: Achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage relative to Docker.

eUZTRoJjNc.one_liner: Multi-step physical-space trajectory objectives and conflict-removing gradient projection improve long-horizon rollouts of PDE foundation models.
eUZTRoJjNc.problem: Adapting pretrained PDE foundation models with multi-step trajectory losses suffers from long-horizon error accumulation and conflicting or imbalanced gradients across future time steps and metrics.
eUZTRoJjNc.method: TEMPO-PDE scores multi-step rollout predictions using field-value errors, spectral discrepancies, and local spatial differences organized into primary and auxiliary post-training objectives. Primary-guided gradient composition projects out auxiliary gradient components that oppose the primary gradient and caps the remaining auxiliary norm without modifying inference architecture.
eUZTRoJjNc.key_idea: Combine multi-horizon field, spectral, and local spatial rollout losses by projecting out opposing auxiliary gradients and bounding auxiliary gradient norms against the primary objective.
eUZTRoJjNc.evidence: Evaluated on five PDE benchmarks comparing time-averaged and final-step rollout errors against post-training baselines.

dj41CyOSnJ.one_liner: Interaction-history peer profiling trained with auxiliary reinforcement learning rewards enables multi-agent LLMs to weight peers by estimated reliability.
dj41CyOSnJ.problem: Agents in LLM multi-agent systems conform sycophantically to misleading peers because they evaluate isolated responses without tracking peer reliability across past interactions.
dj41CyOSnJ.method: Epistemic Context Learning (ECL) formalizes history-aware reference by supplying peers' historical interaction records as context and constructing explicit peer reliability profiles before generating predictions. Reinforcement learning with auxiliary trust-modeling rewards optimizes both reliability estimation and final answer aggregation.
dj41CyOSnJ.key_idea: Build explicit peer reliability profiles from historical multi-agent interactions and optimize profile-conditioned reasoning via reinforcement learning with auxiliary rewards.
dj41CyOSnJ.evidence: Evaluated across diverse multi-agent configurations comparing Qwen 3-4B against history-agnostic Qwen 3-30B as well as larger models.
dj41CyOSnJ.claimed_gains: ECL enables Qwen 3-4B to outperform a history-agnostic Qwen 3-30B baseline (8× larger) and raises larger evaluated models to 100% accuracy.

9Si0N4FH1r.one_liner: Event-aligned visual imagination supervision and an action-chunk execution validity head focus world-action models on task-critical interactions.
9Si0N4FH1r.problem: World-Action Models generate imagined future frames at fixed uniform time intervals, wasting visual reasoning capacity on routine transitions rather than task-critical interaction events.
9Si0N4FH1r.method: The framework supervises World-Action Models to predict future visual states aligned with key interaction events, allocating fine-grained visual imagination around critical state changes and coarser steps across transitions. An execution validity head predicts the valid prefix of each generated action chunk to truncate redundant actions at inference.
9Si0N4FH1r.key_idea: Align imagined visual-foresight rollouts with task-critical interaction events rather than uniform time steps, and truncate redundant chunked actions with an execution validity head.
9Si0N4FH1r.evidence: Evaluated on DOMINO (including transfer from Level 1) and RoboTwin 2.0 robotic manipulation benchmarks.
9Si0N4FH1r.claimed_gains: The method improves DOMINO success rate by 10.26 percentage points over the baseline while achieving competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0.

jRe4arGREk.one_liner: External memory weaver expresses learned latent tokens as vocabulary-anchored linear combinations of recipient embeddings for cross-model transfer.
jRe4arGREk.problem: Capabilities acquired during post-training remain locked inside a single model's parameter space and tokenizer, requiring repeated retraining for new recipient models.
jRe4arGREk.method: MemAny freezes a small host model during training and routes task adaptation into an external generative memory weaver. Generated latent memory tokens are represented as linear superpositions of token embeddings aligned across tokenizers through shared vocabulary anchors, enabling training-free plug-and-play transfer to frozen recipient models.
jRe4arGREk.key_idea: Train an external latent memory generator on a frozen host and transfer it across tokenizers by expressing latent tokens via shared-vocabulary embedding superpositions.
jRe4arGREk.evidence: Combined with SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation on mathematical/logical reasoning, code generation, and tool-use, transferring Qwen3-4B-Base memory to MiMo-V2-Flash-Base (309B) and HY3-Preview-Base (295B) on AIME24.
jRe4arGREk.claimed_gains: On-policy-distilled memory trained on Qwen3-4B-Base transfers without retraining to MiMo-V2-Flash-Base (309B) and HY3-Preview-Base (295B), improving AIME24 accuracy by up to 33.3 points.

C1gr02UJ6D.one_liner: Permutation-space linkage learning detects true graph arcs during search to jump transitively coupled vertices together in polynomial time.
C1gr02UJ6D.problem: Permutation-space evolutionary algorithms for Feedback Arc Set and topological ordering take weakly exponential time because objective values hide transitive precedence chains.
C1gr02UJ6D.method: The authors adapt binary linkage learning to permutation spaces to detect true underlying graph arcs with zero false positives during fitness evaluations. A coupled mutation operator moves sets of vertices linked by learned arcs together in Randomized Local Search (RLS), handling transitive dependencies implicitly without recovering the full graph.
C1gr02UJ6D.key_idea: Learn exact precedence arcs online in permutation space and mutate arc-connected vertex sets jointly to traverse hidden transitive dependencies.
C1gr02UJ6D.evidence: Supported by runtime proofs showing weakly exponential time for standard RLS on DAG topological ordering versus expected polynomial time (≥ 1/n² per-step progress probability) with linkage-guided mutation.
C1gr02UJ6D.claimed_gains: Linkage-equipped RLS improves fitness or detects a new arc with probability at least 1/n² per non-optimal step, reducing DAG ordering from weakly exponential to expected polynomial time.

uBr2c5KPDY.one_liner: Finite-trace linear temporal logic properties and opportunity-normalized violation metrics audit temporal safety of robotic manipulation rollouts.
uBr2c5KPDY.problem: Endpoint task-completion metrics and static state checks miss temporal manipulation hazards such as cross-contamination, premature release, or unsafe action ordering.
uBr2c5KPDY.method: SafeManip grounds low-level manipulation rollouts into symbolic predicates checked against reusable finite-trace linear temporal logic (LTLf) specifications organized under the cross-task ManipVerse ontology. It computes per-trigger safety metrics that normalize violations by the frequency of safety-relevant trigger opportunities.
uBr2c5KPDY.key_idea: Evaluate manipulation rollouts against ontology-grounded LTLf temporal logic specifications and normalize violation counts by per-policy trigger opportunities.
uBr2c5KPDY.evidence: Instantiated on RoboCasa365 and LIBERO across eight physical and semantic safety categories to audit seven robot foundation-model policies.

NAbP6R3MxV.one_liner: RL-guided multi-source retrieval and bottom-up Byzantine-robust argument-tree aggregation defend tool-augmented LLMs against generative engine optimization poisoning.
NAbP6R3MxV.problem: Retrieval- and tool-augmented LLMs are vulnerable to knowledge corruption and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) poisoning that boost adversarial evidence into reasoning contexts.
NAbP6R3MxV.method: The ToE framework combines reinforcement learning-guided dynamic multi-source retrieval with stance and reliability scoring of retrieved evidence items. Claims are structured into a dynamically expanded argument tree whose node scores are aggregated bottom-up in a Byzantine-robust manner to bound corrupted or conflicting sources.
NAbP6R3MxV.key_idea: Organize RL-retrieved multi-source evidence into a dynamic argument tree scored by stance and reliability, then aggregate claim support bottom-up with Byzantine-robust rules.
NAbP6R3MxV.evidence: Evaluated across four claim-verification datasets and two backbone LLMs under standard settings and controlled GEO poisoning, with component and retrieval-tool ablations.

JOp9P2GsKL.one_liner: Branch-synchronized pruning and second-order Taylor-calibrated attention fused into tiled online softmax accelerate unified multimodal multi-image synthesis.
JOp9P2GsKL.problem: Applying understanding-oriented attention token pruning to multi-image synthesis in Unified Multimodal Models causes inconsistent conditional guidance and pooling-induced bias.
JOp9P2GsKL.method: CATP performs training-free layer-wise context pruning during denoising using Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize token retention across conditioning branches and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) for second-order pooling-bias correction. A Fast Scoring Operator fuses this calibrated scoring directly into tiled online softmax kernels.
JOp9P2GsKL.key_idea: Synchronize layer-wise token pruning across conditioning branches and correct pooling bias via a second-order Taylor-calibrated attention metric fused into tiled online softmax.
JOp9P2GsKL.evidence: Evaluated training-free across Unified Multimodal Models and multi-image synthesis benchmarks against token-reduction baselines.
JOp9P2GsKL.claimed_gains: CATP achieves up to 2.09× attention-core speedup over baseline multi-image synthesis.

TwZI1k8xKz.one_liner: Unified continuous latent tokenizer jointly encodes RGB appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories for diffusion driving world-action models.
TwZI1k8xKz.problem: Driving world models that tokenize camera appearance, LiDAR geometry, and ego motion separately incur redundant computation and cross-modal geometric inconsistency.
TwZI1k8xKz.method: DriveUniTok encodes multi-view appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories into a single decodable continuous latent representation. Freezing DriveUniTok, DriveUniWAM adapts a pretrained video diffusion model with reinforcement learning post-training to predict future unified latents decoded jointly into visual, depth, and trajectory outputs.
TwZI1k8xKz.key_idea: Encode camera appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion into one shared continuous latent predicted by a diffusion world-action model.
TwZI1k8xKz.evidence: Evaluated on NAVSIM with controlled separate-stream comparisons for future prediction, planning, static-region geometric consistency, compute cost, and RL post-training.
TwZI1k8xKz.claimed_gains: On NAVSIM, full multimodal generation uses 46.6% less computation than a separate-stream control, and RL-post-trained DriveUniWAM reaches a PDMS of 91.54.

tWTH8HniQH.one_liner: Per-candidate attention gating interpolates unreliable modality embeddings toward learnable neutral or null directions in multilinear contrastive learning.
tWTH8HniQH.problem: Multilinear inner product objectives in higher-order multimodal contrastive learning allow a single noisy, misaligned, or missing modality to corrupt multiplicative similarity scores.
tWTH8HniQH.method: Gated Symile introduces an attention-based, per-candidate gating mechanism ahead of the multilinear inner product similarity calculation. Unreliable modality inputs are suppressed by interpolating their embeddings toward learnable neutral directions, including an explicit NULL option when cross-modal alignment fails.
tWTH8HniQH.key_idea: Gate each modality per candidate via attention-weighted interpolation toward learnable neutral or explicit NULL directions before computing multilinear inner products.
tWTH8HniQH.evidence: Evaluated on a controlled synthetic fragility benchmark and three real-world trimodal retrieval datasets against multimodal contrastive baselines.

bPFkhCBFz3.one_liner: Multi-protocol continual VLM retrieval benchmark pairs global-gallery evaluation with low-rank adapter routing and selective consolidation.
bPFkhCBFz3.problem: Continual multimodal retrieval evaluations rely on narrow domains, single training protocols, and task-isolated galleries that hide cross-task ranking degradation.
bPFkhCBFz3.method: SCOPE benchmarks continual vision-language retrieval across seven visual domains, three training protocols, and both task-specific and global-gallery settings. As a reference method, Adapter Routing and Consolidation (ARC) combines low-rank adapters with selective parameter consolidation to reduce cross-task interference.
bPFkhCBFz3.key_idea: Evaluate continual VLM retrieval across global and task-specific galleries while mitigating cross-task interference via routed low-rank adapters and selective consolidation.
bPFkhCBFz3.evidence: Evaluated across seven heterogeneous visual domains, three continual training protocols, and task-specific versus global retrieval galleries against continual learning and fine-tuning baselines.

O4HXAtmx7v.one_liner: Evolves task-preserving user personas through behavioral mutations and Pareto selection to expose agent-specific failures.
O4HXAtmx7v.problem: Cooperative standardized user simulators miss realistic interaction failures, while failure-oriented search can invalidate the underlying task.
O4HXAtmx7v.method: TIPER evolves persistent user personas using reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. It searches for agent-specific user policies that reduce performance while keeping tasks valid and solvable, then organizes discovered behaviors into a failure taxonomy.
O4HXAtmx7v.key_idea: Search persistent persona behaviors with task-validity-constrained reflection and Pareto selection to expose weaknesses without making tasks unsolvable.
O4HXAtmx7v.evidence: Experiments cover four interactive-agent benchmarks, 12 GPT-5.4 settings, and 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with held-out avg@3 evaluation.
O4HXAtmx7v.claimed_gains: TIPER reduces held-out avg@3 by 5.8–33.7 percentage points across all 12 GPT-5.4 settings and lowers scores in all 28 agent-domain pairs with a median reduction of 22.9 points.

i8UJ5BDjqm.one_liner: Optimizes a hierarchical Sim(3) chunk-level pose graph followed by per-frame SE(3) optimization for long-horizon 3D reconstruction.
i8UJ5BDjqm.problem: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models must process long videos in overlapping chunks, creating inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate camera estimates.
i8UJ5BDjqm.method: HiP3R first optimizes a chunk-level Sim(3) pose graph to fix global layout and scale, then holds that layout fixed to estimate one shared SE(3) camera per frame without retraining.
i8UJ5BDjqm.key_idea: Resolves global scale drift with a chunk-level Sim(3) pose graph before solving for consistent per-frame SE(3) poses under fixed chunk transforms.

jydXtdSq5A.one_liner: Generates SE(2) pose hypotheses via ray-floorplan matching and disambiguates repetitive layouts with SE(2)-aware contrastive learning.
jydXtdSq5A.problem: Repetitive indoor floorplans cause structural aliasing, producing multi-modal pose distributions that geometric ray matching cannot disambiguate.
jydXtdSq5A.method: DisCo regresses depth-aware 2D rays for ray-floorplan matching, extracts hypotheses via SE(2) clustering, and applies an SE(2)-aware contrastive disambiguation objective with structured pose perturbations.
jydXtdSq5A.key_idea: Clusters ray-matched pose candidates in SE(2) and refines them with a contrastive disambiguation loss over structured pose perturbations.

j1LlI08qs0.one_liner: Uses one shared LLM policy to select from a persistent reasoning-skill library and generate solutions conditioned on it via hierarchical RL.
j1LlI08qs0.problem: RL with verifiable rewards treats each math problem as a fresh episode, leaving skill abstraction and selection outside policy optimization.
j1LlI08qs0.method: ARISE treats reasoning patterns as options in a hierarchical RL framework where one shared policy scores persistent library skills via conditional log-likelihood, generates conditioned solutions, and infers new skills from ground-truth traces.
j1LlI08qs0.key_idea: Unifies option selection and intra-option solution generation in one LLM policy over a persistent, trace-inferred mathematical skill library.

tpC55b8vOJ.one_liner: Supervises spatial-contextual dense attention with a deep registration loss to align misaligned query and context medical images.
tpC55b8vOJ.problem: Medical in-context segmentation models assume query and context images are spatially aligned, which rarely holds in clinical practice.
tpC55b8vOJ.method: OmniSeg combines SpotBlock (spatial and contextual dense attention) with a deep registration loss that supervises attention to dynamically align query and context representations.
tpC55b8vOJ.key_idea: Supervises a joint spatial-contextual attention block with a deep registration loss to align query and context features during in-context segmentation.
tpC55b8vOJ.evidence: Evaluations across 10 held-out medical image segmentation datasets.
tpC55b8vOJ.claimed_gains: Yields an average gain of 9.8 Dice points against the best baseline across 10 held-out datasets.

NzLonFYOH5.one_liner: Jointly optimizes scene-wide 3DGS watermarking and saliency-guided adversarial edit deterrence.
NzLonFYOH5.problem: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting protections handle either ownership watermarking or edit deterrence, but not both simultaneously.
NzLonFYOH5.method: GuardMarkGS combines a scene-wide Gaussian watermarking objective with an adversarial branch using latent-anchor separation, denoising-trajectory diversion, and cross-attention diversion weighted by update-saliency Gaussian selection.
NzLonFYOH5.key_idea: Co-optimizes scene-wide 3DGS watermarking with trajectory/attention-diverting adversarial perturbations concentrated on saliency-selected Gaussians.
NzLonFYOH5.evidence: Experiments on scenes from Mip-NeRF 360 and Instruct-NeRF2NeRF.

ZXL40JrnWo.one_liner: Characterizes finite-budget winner reachability in LLM voting and derives an exact early-stopping locking certificate.
ZXL40JrnWo.problem: Under a fixed inference call budget, a correct answer discovered during LLM voting may fail to accumulate enough votes to win plurality.
ZXL40JrnWo.method: The authors analyze vote-state dynamics and remaining call budgets to derive a sharp recoverability threshold, finite-horizon endpoint probabilities under iid response laws, and a gold-free singleton-reachability locking certificate for early stopping.
ZXL40JrnWo.key_idea: Tracks the contracting set of reachable plurality winners given realized votes and remaining budget to certify the earliest prefix where all continuations yield the same winner.
ZXL40JrnWo.evidence: Supported by theoretical derivations of recoverability thresholds and empirical evaluation on LLM voting trajectories.

LzvTlb7B3s.one_liner: Accelerates unified autoregressive image generation by conditioning each row in parallel on vertically aligned predecessors.
LzvTlb7B3s.problem: Standard raster-order autoregressive image generation requires HW sequential decoding steps for an H x W image, creating an inference bottleneck.
LzvTlb7B3s.method: ScanAR redefines visual token predecessors without altering the backbone, vocabulary, or output head: the first row decodes left-to-right, and each subsequent row generates all tokens in parallel conditioned on vertically aligned predecessors in prior rows, reducing sequential steps to H+W.
LzvTlb7B3s.key_idea: Redefines 2D visual token predecessors so rows after the first decode in parallel conditioned on vertically aligned tokens above them, cutting steps from HW to H+W.
LzvTlb7B3s.evidence: Experiments on Emu3.5 evaluating GenEval scores and wall-clock decoding speedup.
LzvTlb7B3s.claimed_gains: On Emu3.5, ScanAR improves the GenEval score by 1.88 points and achieves 27.7x wall-clock speedup.

PTf4tPbIbN.one_liner: Traces model explanations throughout training to study how TCR-epitope predictors organize structural and sequence evidence.
PTf4tPbIbN.problem: Post-hoc interpretability methods give limited insight into how scientific models evolve and organize predictive evidence during training.
PTf4tPbIbN.method: Explainability from Training (EFT) tracks attribution explanations across training epochs. The authors also build TCR-XAI2, a benchmark of 388 resolved TCR-epitope structures paired with structures predicted by five folding models.
PTf4tPbIbN.key_idea: Traces explanation attributions across training epochs to reveal how architectures organize and resolve conflicting evidence over learning.
PTf4tPbIbN.evidence: Evaluations of four TCR-epitope models (TCR-SRIM, TULIP, MixTCRpred, NetTCR-2.2) on the 388-structure TCR-XAI2 benchmark.

992CWkAwEr.one_liner: Disentangles DiT flow-matching velocity fields into orthogonal semantic and emotion components for continuous speech emotion control.
992CWkAwEr.problem: Instruction- and steering-based TTS models struggle to control emotional intensity and temporal extent independently of linguistic content.
992CWkAwEr.method: EmoScale decomposes a DiT flow-matching TTS velocity field into semantic and emotion branches without external emotion embeddings, enforcing orthogonality between them to enable linear interpolation of emotional intensity.
992CWkAwEr.key_idea: Orthogonalizes an emotion velocity branch against the semantic velocity field inside a DiT flow-matching TTS model.
992CWkAwEr.evidence: Evaluations of emotional intensity and localized expression control in DiT-based flow-matching speech synthesis.

m9BaD4FirT.one_liner: Reduces verified analog circuits into recovery tasks and iteratively escalates specifications for recursive agent self-training.
m9BaD4FirT.problem: Complete-design successes are too scarce in analog circuit design to bootstrap self-training agents.
m9BaD4FirT.method: VERA creates recovery tasks by altering starting states of verified circuits while preserving specifications, supervises on verified progress/repair steps from successful rollouts, and searches for harder-specification seeds after each update.
m9BaD4FirT.key_idea: Couples verified circuit reduction into certified recovery tasks with iterative discovery of stronger-specification seeds under a fixed verifier.
m9BaD4FirT.evidence: Recursive self-training experiments on a 9B learner across 180 held-out circuit designs (eight pipelines) and two external circuit benchmarks.
m9BaD4FirT.claimed_gains: One update raises 9B complete-design success from 0/180 to 77/180 (42.8%; 42.6 +/- 2.8% over eight pipelines) versus 47/180 (26.1%) for SFT, and three updates reach 68.1 +/- 3.1%, exceeding fixed-bank and same-spec renewal by 13.8 and 7.8 points.

NhQvQBrt8l.one_liner: Revises a shared logit localization state across DINOv3, SAM2, and forensic stages with gated signed corrections.
NhQvQBrt8l.problem: Existing image manipulation localization methods fuse heterogeneous representations as equal-status features, obscuring how each source should modify the prediction.
NhQvQBrt8l.method: RoGRE maintains a shared logit-valued localization state initialized by DINOv3, then refined sequentially by SAM2 spatial features and forensic residual features. Each stage proposes a bounded signed correction regulated by a gate conditioned on the incoming state and stage evidence before SAM2 decoding.
NhQvQBrt8l.key_idea: Maintains a shared logit localization state updated by role-specific bounded signed corrections regulated by state- and evidence-conditioned gates.
NhQvQBrt8l.evidence: Evaluated under CAT-Net and MVSS-Net protocols with ablations on correction order and state-dependent gating.
NhQvQBrt8l.claimed_gains: RoGRE achieves mean pixel-level F1 scores of 0.888 and 0.813 under the CAT-Net and MVSS-Net protocols, respectively.

04oXFEiXY3.one_liner: Indexes document chunks as event-entity rows in an append-only SQL table to chain multi-hop evidence via dynamic joins.
04oXFEiXY3.problem: Dense retrieval struggles with multi-hop and structured constraints, while offline knowledge graphs fragment semantics and complicate incremental index updates.
04oXFEiXY3.method: SAG (SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation) represents each chunk as an event paired with its entities—a latent hyperedge—stored as incidence rows in an append-only relational table. At query time, SQL joins on shared entities dynamically form a query-scoped neighborhood while preserving full original chunks as evidence.
04oXFEiXY3.key_idea: Stores chunk-level event-entity hyperedges in an append-only SQL incidence table and activates multi-hop neighborhoods at query time via SQL joins on shared entities.
04oXFEiXY3.evidence: Evaluated on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue for both retrieval recall and end-to-end QA against retrieval and graph-RAG baselines.
04oXFEiXY3.claimed_gains: On MuSiQue, SAG reaches 80.36% Recall@5, outperforming the strongest baseline by 11.52 points.

7qpkedfwN3.one_liner: Refines JEPA latent world-model geometry using a permutation-equivariant operator over goal-relative features and executed outcomes.
7qpkedfwN3.problem: Latent distance in pretrained world models does not reliably reflect which candidate action will succeed among competing futures.
7qpkedfwN3.method: D-JEPA uses a bounded, permutation-equivariant operator over goal-relative predictive features and ordinal outcome evidence to refine pretrained predictive geometry via restricted predictor adaptation. It realizes this decision structure in JEPA-compatible future representations for latent-distance planning.
7qpkedfwN3.key_idea: Learns decision-relevant ordinal relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes and encodes them into JEPA-compatible latent representations.
7qpkedfwN3.evidence: Evaluated across latent control, manipulation (PushT, RoboTwin), pretrained action-producing models, physical robots, and autonomous driving.
7qpkedfwN3.claimed_gains: Achieves 87.89% success on PushT, a 15.04-point average gain on RoboTwin, and a 17-point gain on physical robot tasks.

xTJsbcwE5b.one_liner: Bounds how local posterior geometry errors transfer to weighted manifold forms and tests conditional moment supervision.
xTJsbcwE5b.problem: It is unclear when accurate local posterior geometry recovers accurate weighted function energies on a manifold under ambient extensions.
xTJsbcwE5b.method: The authors derive a gradient-dependent bound separating learning error, finite-noise geometric bias, and numerical integration, and analyze exact Gaussian posteriors on circles. They compare covariance models trained with sample residuals versus conditional second moments under oracle-assisted centering and known-dimensional filtering.
xTJsbcwE5b.key_idea: Separates learning-induced normal error from finite-noise bias via a gradient-dependent bound and compares sample-residual against conditional second-moment supervision.
xTJsbcwE5b.evidence: Theoretical bounds on circle examples and controlled experiments on image-translation manifolds across four image-initialization pairs.
xTJsbcwE5b.claimed_gains: Conditional supervision with oracle-assisted centering and filtering reduces mean linear-form error from 24.80% to 3.73%.

OvN3HewjcR.one_liner: Routes heterogeneous tokamak plasma predictors across timesteps and variables using rollout-aware Mixture-of-Experts frameworks.
OvN3HewjcR.problem: Single-step tokamak plasma predictors fail to maintain accuracy across all physical variables and long recursive rollout horizons.
OvN3HewjcR.method: The paper compares four Mixture-of-Experts routing frameworks (Baseline-MoE, DaD-MoE, PPO-MoE, and FIRE) over a frozen bank of heterogeneous physical predictors to adaptively select experts per timestep and variable.
OvN3HewjcR.key_idea: Uses rollout-aware Mixture-of-Experts routing over frozen heterogeneous physical predictors to select different experts per timestep and variable.
OvN3HewjcR.evidence: Evaluations on simulated MAST-U tokamak data and real-world device measurements compare the four MoE routing frameworks.

boOHV1kROZ.one_liner: Extends frozen geometric transformers with a Mamba SS2D recurrent adapter for cross-window long-video 3D reconstruction.
boOHV1kROZ.problem: Windowed inference in pretrained geometric transformers cuts computational cost on long videos but breaks feature-level communication across windows.
boOHV1kROZ.method: Mamba-VGGT attaches a recurrent adapter using a Mamba two-dimensional selective scan (SS2D) to a frozen Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer, jointly processing incoming state and current patch tokens for residual updates and memory writes with state decay and periodic segment resets.
boOHV1kROZ.key_idea: Couples a frozen windowed geometric transformer with a Mamba SS2D recurrent memory adapter that reads and updates fixed-capacity cross-window spatial state.
boOHV1kROZ.evidence: Evaluations on 2,000-frame KITTI-360 sequences and 8,000- and 10,000-frame VBR sequences, plus mixer-replacement ablations.
boOHV1kROZ.claimed_gains: Reduces mean absolute trajectory error by 42.3% and mean LiDAR-supported reconstruction distance by 56.3% on 2,000-frame KITTI-360 relative to LoGeR with sliding-window attention.

0MxrxYIueT.one_liner: Defends vision-language models at test time by bending flattened early ViT residual trajectories via input updates.
0MxrxYIueT.problem: Existing test-time adversarial defenses rely on multi-view transforms or closed-set labels and ignore how perturbations flatten early ViT residual trajectories and amplify in deep MLPs.
0MxrxYIueT.method: CURB performs test-time input updates to bend abnormally flattened early residual trajectories in the ViT visual encoder, curbing adversarial deviation amplification across open-ended generation and zero-shot classification without relying on output spaces.
0MxrxYIueT.key_idea: Applies test-time input updates to bend flattened early ViT residual trajectories before deviations amplify through deep MLP branches.
0MxrxYIueT.evidence: Experiments on LLaVA-1.5-7B and InternVL3.5-8B across open-ended generation and zero-shot classification tasks.

rB9sS9hPCT.one_liner: Generates task-adaptive multi-agent communication topologies via a shared language interface trained with utility-aware DPO.
rB9sS9hPCT.problem: Existing graph-based multi-agent topology generators encode tasks into intermediate representations and fail to distinguish fine-grained collaboration demands between semantically similar tasks.
rB9sS9hPCT.method: PLASMAS jointly models task semantics, agent roles, and topology outputs in a shared language interface following a language-based graph foundation model paradigm. It trains the generator with direct preference optimization using utility-aware pairwise preferences balancing task effectiveness and execution cost.
rB9sS9hPCT.key_idea: Jointly represents task semantics, agent roles, and topologies in a unified language interface trained with utility-aware direct preference optimization.
rB9sS9hPCT.evidence: Experiments evaluate collaboration allocation and task performance across semantically similar tasks of varying difficulty.

rQa3MHoUQG.one_liner: Generates zero-shot time series from one reference using quantized multiscale state-transition codebooks and flow matching.
rQa3MHoUQG.problem: Existing time-series generation models focus on in-domain settings and cannot generalize zero-shot from a single reference sequence in an unseen domain.
rQa3MHoUQG.method: MarkovTS pretrains an encoder with a state codebook quantizing multiscale patches and a transition codebook capturing adjacent interval context, which conditions a flow-matching generator. At inference, State-Transition Recombination recombines code blocks from windows of the single reference while Gaussian noise supplies waveform variation.
rQa3MHoUQG.key_idea: Conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on quantized multiscale state and transition codebooks with window-level State-Transition Recombination for single-reference zero-shot generation.
rQa3MHoUQG.evidence: Evaluations across 12 unseen target datasets and downstream multivariate time-series forecasting tasks.

jd8BPmEk7F.one_liner: Paired abstract and coding tasks expose failures to transfer reusable-tool budget allocation across contexts.
jd8BPmEk7F.problem: Agents need to invest fixed budgets in reusable tools rather than create many one-offs, but their deliberate allocation behavior across contexts is untested.
jd8BPmEk7F.method: AllocBench pairs an abstract text-based allocation task with a code-construction task under fixed budgets. SeAM separates the build decision from implementation using a distinct allocator model.
jd8BPmEk7F.key_idea: Compare matched abstract and script-writing allocation decisions, then offload tool-building decisions to a separate allocator.
jd8BPmEk7F.evidence: Experiments cover several frontier model families, per-model failure analyses, a policy-trained open-source Qwen model, held-out lexical variations, and SeAM with Claude Opus.

xSpcpOOUwS.one_liner: Predicted future physical states guide residual action corrections before locomotion deviations occur.
xSpcpOOUwS.problem: Joint end-to-end optimization can undertrain precision objectives, while reactive residual control waits until locomotion deviations become observable.
xSpcpOOUwS.method: LocoWM predicts future physical states from proprioceptive history and a proposed base action using an action-conditioned world model. A residual adapter conditions on that sequence, with two-stage training that freezes locomotion and dynamics modules during adapter learning.
xSpcpOOUwS.key_idea: Generate additive residual corrections from forecast physical-state deviations rather than observed deviations alone.
xSpcpOOUwS.evidence: Terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery experiments compare control precision and disturbance response with end-to-end and reactive residual baselines.

Wf7ETBmza9.one_liner: Trajectory-calibrated rewards and reliability-aware fusion adapt LLM-generated reward programs as robot policies improve.
Wf7ETBmza9.problem: Reward programs held fixed during policy-training cycles may stop guiding new contact configurations and near-success behaviors.
Wf7ETBmza9.method: TRACE-RL combines an LLM-generated task-prior reward with a trajectory-calibrated reward and reliability-aware fusion in its inner loop. Its outer loop jointly refines reward, trajectory-scoring, and evaluation functions from structured feedback while retaining validated reward-model and policy states.
Wf7ETBmza9.key_idea: Calibrate dense rewards against evolving policy trajectories and refine their scoring and evaluation functions across outer iterations.
Wf7ETBmza9.evidence: The supplied abstract describes inner- and outer-loop training but truncates before reporting experiments or numerical results.

qF7XTujCQL.one_liner: Plans protein-preserving full-length mRNA edits with an uncertainty-aware MPC over a preference-independent latent world model.
qF7XTujCQL.problem: Optimizing full-length mRNA across coding and untranslated regions involves interacting multi-objective trade-offs where greedy local edits miss globally optimal designs.
qF7XTujCQL.method: mRNAWM encodes full-length mRNA sequences into latent states and learns protein-conditioned, action-conditioned dynamics over protein-preserving edits. An uncertainty-aware model predictive controller plans multi-step edit trajectories over the shared dynamics model to support flexible objective trade-offs.
qF7XTujCQL.key_idea: Learns preference-independent latent transition dynamics over protein-preserving mRNA edits and plans multi-step designs via uncertainty-aware MPC.
qF7XTujCQL.evidence: Evaluated across eight primary mRNA design metrics comparing full-mRNA and CDS-only configurations against external baselines.
qF7XTujCQL.claimed_gains: Outperforms all external methods on seven of eight primary metrics, reaching a codon adaptation index (CAI) of 0.945 and full-mRNA MFE/nt of -0.401.

BULWP9S7xY.one_liner: Introduces a 400-problem multi-image physics sequence-completion benchmark with visual, reduced-context, and text-state diagnostic protocols.
BULWP9S7xY.problem: Evaluating whether multimodal LLMs actually extract physical states and verify dynamics is difficult when answer choices can be distinguished by text cues alone.
BULWP9S7xY.method: PhysCot provides 400 four-frame visual sequence-completion problems across eight physics subfields where models choose the fifth frame from four rendered physical-state perturbations. Three diagnostic protocols probe full visual sequences, reduced temporal context (PhysCot^S), and textual candidate states (PhysCot^T).
BULWP9S7xY.key_idea: Constructs rendered physical-state perturbation distractors paired with full-visual, reduced-context, and text-state diagnostic protocols.
BULWP9S7xY.evidence: Benchmarked multimodal large language models across 400 synthetic simulator-rendered problems in eight physics subfields.
BULWP9S7xY.claimed_gains: No evaluated model exceeds 50% on the full visual protocol, whereas the strongest model reaches 78.56% in the mixed text-augmented condition.

t8604nwCPV.one_liner: Conditions a text-to-audio flow-matching model on concatenated reference voice latents with high-noise-biased timesteps.
t8604nwCPV.problem: Reference-conditioned multi-speaker audio models require structured per-turn supervision and produce studio-clean speech lacking natural ambient acoustics, while naive conditioning suffers from a Reference Shortcut.
t8604nwCPV.method: ScenA concatenates multiple reference voice latents with identity-aware positional encodings into a pretrained in-the-wild text-to-audio flow-matching model guided by a free-form scene prompt. It uses a high-noise-biased timestep schedule during training so the model cannot match speakers by acoustic similarity alone and must follow the text prompt.
t8604nwCPV.key_idea: Concatenates identity-encoded reference voice latents into a flow-matching audio foundation model trained with high-noise-biased timesteps to block acoustic shortcuts.
t8604nwCPV.evidence: Formulated and trained on multi-speaker audio scene generation from an in-the-wild text-to-audio flow-matching foundation model.

ngWiMwdgHU.one_liner: Benchmarks coding agents on editing executable Minecraft and Terraria worlds across four levels of intervention depth.
ngWiMwdgHU.problem: Interactive world modeling focuses on generating new environments while deliberately editing existing executable worlds and preserving untouched behavior remains under-evaluated.
ngWiMwdgHU.method: The authors formulate world editing along an intervention-depth axis (property, entity, dynamics, and system edits) instantiated via game modding in IGMWorld. They build IGMBench with 110 tasks, 1.1K criteria, and 2.7K deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks across Minecraft and Terraria.
ngWiMwdgHU.key_idea: Evaluates agent world-editing reliability across increasing coupling depth using deterministic executable, behavioral, preservation, and visual game-modding checks.
ngWiMwdgHU.evidence: Evaluated frontier coding agents on IGMBench (110 tasks, 1.1K criteria, 2.7K executable checks) across Minecraft and Terraria.
ngWiMwdgHU.claimed_gains: The strongest coding-agent configuration solves 80.9% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion and achieves 95.5% criterion-level performance.

3RYsgXS0uj.one_liner: Embeds multi-bit watermarks in autoregressive audio via payload-driven scheduling over a codec-confusion-aware token-cluster space.
3RYsgXS0uj.problem: Audio codec processing alters recovered token sequences in autoregressive audio models, breaking watermark detection, while most prior methods support only zero-bit detection.
3RYsgXS0uj.method: MARC builds a codec-aware token-cluster space combining intrinsic token representations with substitution confusion patterns measured across retokenization and multiple codecs. It embeds multi-bit payloads through payload-driven cluster scheduling and recovers them via key-assisted verification on retokenized waveforms.
3RYsgXS0uj.key_idea: Clusters audio tokens jointly by intrinsic representations and multi-codec confusion patterns for payload-driven multi-bit watermark scheduling.
3RYsgXS0uj.evidence: Evaluated on speech, dialogue, and music autoregressive audio generation under unmodified and codec-attack conditions.
3RYsgXS0uj.claimed_gains: Achieves an average of 97.3% bit extraction accuracy on unmodified watermarked audio.

92uyXoygDV.one_liner: Co-evolves a trainable step-level rubric model with an LLM agent via terminal-outcome trajectory decomposition.
92uyXoygDV.problem: Scalar RL rewards fail to explain trajectory quality, while existing rubric methods rely on frozen closed-source judges over full trajectories rather than adaptive step-level guidance.
92uyXoygDV.method: ARCO (Adaptive Rubric CO-evolution) trains a rubric model to generate action-specific per-step natural-language criteria and dense rubric-conditioned rewards, co-evolving it with the agent policy on shared on-policy rollouts. After warmup, trajectory decomposition fits step rewards to terminal outcomes without step labels or external judges.
92uyXoygDV.key_idea: Co-evolves a step-level action-specific rubric reward model with the agent using trajectory decomposition fitted to terminal outcomes.
92uyXoygDV.evidence: Evaluated on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue across two open-source backbones with ablations on rubric specificity, criteria count, and rubric-model scale.

I55xUrULhd.one_liner: Trains LLM agent memory managers with hybrid QA accuracy and Conditional Mutual Information intrinsic rewards.
I55xUrULhd.problem: RL memory managers trained solely on sampled downstream QA accuracy overlook memories that are non-redundant and valuable for future unqueried user needs.
I55xUrULhd.method: UniMem-R1 combines extrinsic QA supervision with an intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information (CMI) reward measuring the information gain of newly added memories from recent dialogue conditioned on the existing memory bank. This jointly scores task relevance and non-redundancy during RL training.
I55xUrULhd.key_idea: Augments extrinsic QA rewards with an intrinsic Conditional Mutual Information reward measuring non-redundant dialogue information gain given existing memory.
I55xUrULhd.evidence: Evaluated on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and MemoryAgentBench against RL baselines on matched-size backbones and larger LLMs.

4txZiEYKne.one_liner: Anchors retail demand forecasts on convex combinations of recent patch means with three correction heads and conditional window-total loss.
4txZiEYKne.problem: Continuous-signal forecasters drift below the level of nonnegative integer retail demand counts, while per-day losses ignore weekly aggregate totals needed for replenishment.
4txZiEYKne.method: PatchTransferNet anchors forecasts on a convex combination of recent patch means refined by three small heads and adds a window-total loss term to quantile loss when supported by zero-mass and offset-share diagnostics.
4txZiEYKne.key_idea: Combines a convex patch-mean level anchor and three lightweight correction heads with a diagnostic-gated window-total aggregate loss.
4txZiEYKne.evidence: Evaluated on seven demand runs, FreshRetailNet-50K, M5, four external case studies, and ten classical time-series benchmarks.
4txZiEYKne.claimed_gains: Reaches 28.51% median WAPE on FreshRetailNet-50K and 0.978 median WRMSSE on M5.

E3m3R2NHVg.one_liner: Infers dynamic content masks from paired representation differences in InfoMax SSL to block-identify causal variables without view labels.
E3m3R2NHVg.problem: InfoMax self-supervised learning entangles causal variables with spurious correlations, while multi-view causal representation learning requires explicit view labels and intractable non-convex optimization.
E3m3R2NHVg.method: Disc-InfoMax dynamically infers a shared content mask from empirical differences between paired representations with an asymptotic block-identifiability guarantee, and BayesDisc provides a tractable optimization algorithm usable with standard deep learning optimizers.
E3m3R2NHVg.key_idea: Infers a dynamic shared content mask from paired representation differences for causal block-identifiability and optimizes it via the tractable BayesDisc algorithm.
E3m3R2NHVg.evidence: Asymptotic block-identifiability proof plus empirical evaluation against InfoMax SSL baselines across several datasets.

S7H9h3eNjo.one_liner: Breaks JEPA rotational non-identifiability by pairing an anisotropic predictor with a pairwise representation regularizer.
S7H9h3eNjo.problem: Standard JEPA predictors absorb arbitrary rotations of representation space, mixing physical factors across coordinates, while encoders can favor overly predictable nonlinear features over true factors.
S7H9h3eNjo.method: AP-JEPA replaces the dense JEPA predictor with an anisotropic predictor whose loss splits into a rotation-invariant subspace term and a basis-aligning cross-talk term separating factors by timescale. PairSIGReg jointly regularizes consecutive representations to rule out spurious predictable features and recover the factor subspace.
S7H9h3eNjo.key_idea: Uses an anisotropic predictor to break rotational invariance via timescale cross-talk and PairSIGReg to jointly constrain consecutive representations.
S7H9h3eNjo.evidence: Theoretical loss-decomposition and regularizer analysis plus evaluation across six dynamical and image benchmarks.

G1Jl1Tj6uV.one_liner: Introduces the LogicEval-X benchmark and trains LLMs for symbolic solver delegation via Tool-Integrated MCTS.
G1Jl1Tj6uV.problem: Existing logical reasoning benchmarks have too few entities and clues, and LLMs suffer from prolonged, unreliable hypothesis enumeration as logical complexity grows.
G1Jl1Tj6uV.method: The authors build LogicEval-X (944 expert-verified problems averaging 8.31 entities, 12.47 attributes, and 18.39 clues) and propose Tool-Integrated MCTS (T-MCTS), which explores symbolic formulations and external solver calls to generate solver-verified trajectories and process-level rewards for post-training.
G1Jl1Tj6uV.key_idea: Runs MCTS over symbolic formulations and external solver interactions to collect solver-verified trajectories and process rewards for LLM post-training.
G1Jl1Tj6uV.evidence: Evaluated 10 LLMs on LogicEval-X (944 problems) in the direct-answer setting and trained models with T-MCTS.
G1Jl1Tj6uV.claimed_gains: In direct-answer evaluation on LogicEval-X, the highest-scoring baseline (GPT-5.5) achieves 52.65% accuracy; T-MCTS gains are not stated.

rlDjPXvqcW.one_liner: Synthesizes query-adaptive multimodal in-context demonstrations at inference time using toolchains for code rendering, image generation, and perception.
rlDjPXvqcW.problem: Multimodal in-context learning methods retrieve demonstrations from a fixed corpus, failing when no corpus examples match a target query's task and reasoning schema.
rlDjPXvqcW.method: SynMIC abstracts each target query into a content, task, and reasoning synthesis specification, plans demonstrations with new visual scenarios, queries, pre-committed answers, and visual constraints, and executes dynamically assembled toolchains over code-based rendering, image generation/editing, and auxiliary perception.
rlDjPXvqcW.key_idea: Abstracts target queries into task-and-reasoning schemas and synthesizes tailored multimodal demonstrations on the fly via assembled rendering, image-generation, and perception toolchains.
rlDjPXvqcW.evidence: Evaluated as a self-evolving agentic framework for inference-time multimodal in-context learning.

hEDqFXFy0v.one_liner: Evaluates source fidelity of grammar-constrained symbolic text compression by comparing exact deductive closures against a reference equation system.
hEDqFXFy0v.problem: Reconstruction distance, downstream accuracy, and syntax checkers cannot tell whether lossy symbolic compression preserves the source's factual consequences rather than producing self-consistent mistranslations.
hEDqFXFy0v.method: The authors construct an arithmetic micro-world reference representing source facts as equations, decode compressed symbolic codes back into equations with a fixed decoder, and compare their exact deductive closures independently of syntactic well-formedness.
hEDqFXFy0v.key_idea: Decodes grammar-constrained symbolic codes into equations and measures agreement of exact deductive closures against a constructed source reference.
hEDqFXFy0v.evidence: Controlled arithmetic micro-worlds testing learned translators from 70M to 2.8B parameters (including Pythia) against compact structured controls and learned baselines across matched byte and token budgets.
hEDqFXFy0v.claimed_gains: Across byte budgets, the best learned trace translator achieves 0.67 area under the closure-agreement curve versus 0.86 for the strongest compact structured control.

olaYRgMI0j.one_liner: Estimates agent skills' marginal causal effects via randomized masking to rewrite skill libraries and suppress harmful skills per task.
olaYRgMI0j.problem: LLM agents accumulate natural-language skills that appear plausible but can degrade performance on specific tasks where they are retrieved.
olaYRgMI0j.method: ASSAY runs randomized skill masking across development tasks to estimate each skill's marginal causal effect under sampled skill contexts. These task-indexed profiles guide offline conditional skill rewrites and are aggregated across similar development tasks at test time to suppress harmful skills.
olaYRgMI0j.key_idea: Uses randomized masking on development tasks to estimate task-indexed causal skill effects for offline rewriting and similarity-guided test-time skill suppression.
olaYRgMI0j.evidence: Evaluated across seven models and four providers on AppWorld (test_normal and test_challenge) and τ-bench retail against ACE, random masking, and global-score masking.
olaYRgMI0j.claimed_gains: On GPT-5.1 AppWorld test_normal, ASSAY reaches 77.4% completion versus 70.8% for ACE (76.8% with regenerated attribution), beats random and global-score masking by 7.4 and 4.2 percentage points, and rises from 49.9% with ACE to 66.4% on test_challenge.

2SAyle7ug7.one_liner: Marginalizes over failure-onset uncertainty to produce soft transition-effectiveness supervision for robot policy credit reassignment.
2SAyle7ug7.problem: Sparse episode outcomes and elapsed-time progress signals misassign credit in robot rollouts because successful episodes contain wasted steps and failed episodes contain productive ones.
2SAyle7ug7.method: Event-Grounded Credit Reassignment (ECR) learns local transition effectiveness from episode outcomes, human interventions, and sparse failure-onset annotations by marginalizing over plausible failure-onset locations to create soft transition labels. These estimates revise value targets for advantage-conditioned learning (RECAP) and rewards for offline (IQL) and online (RL Token) RL.
2SAyle7ug7.key_idea: Marginalizes over uncertain failure-onset timestamps from sparse annotations and interventions to generate soft transition-effectiveness labels revising value targets and RL rewards.
2SAyle7ug7.evidence: Instantiated with RECAP, IQL, and RL Token and evaluated across four simulation and four real-world manipulation tasks plus offline transition classification.
2SAyle7ug7.claimed_gains: Improves mean success rate over RECAP by 31.0 percentage points with 2.78× mean throughput across four simulation and four real-world tasks, and achieves 95.3% mean AUROC and 93.3% mean AP offline.

JmiLzhokyU.one_liner: Optimizes discrete LLM agentic workflows continuously via joint artifact-description embeddings and parallel-transported barycentric momentum.
JmiLzhokyU.problem: Discrete, non-differentiable multi-LLM agentic workflows cannot directly convert external environment feedback into explicit continuous optimization directions.
JmiLzhokyU.method: SemanticRelaxation combines Semantic Representation Learning (SRL), which embeds descriptions and artifacts into a joint space, with Barycentric Semantic Optimization (BSO), which computes update directions via barycentric aggregation and parallel-transported trajectory momentum, then retrieves semantic trajectories to guide executable artifact refinements.
JmiLzhokyU.key_idea: Embeds descriptions and artifacts jointly and applies barycentric aggregation with parallel-transported momentum to map continuous semantic directions back to discrete workflow refinements.
JmiLzhokyU.evidence: Evaluated on benchmarks spanning Agentic Workflows, Code Generation, Molecular Editing, and Neural Architecture Search.

ykR0H995N8.one_liner: Retains multiscale hierarchical next-token prediction discrepancies as structured risk features for supervised task-adaptive time-series anomaly detection.
ykR0H995N8.problem: Collapsing temporal-prediction deviations into a single anomaly score conflates regularity violations with task-specific anomalies when identical deviations are benign in one task and anomalous in another.
ykR0H995N8.method: HieraNTP pretrains a multiscale tokenizer and causal hierarchical next-token predictor, preserving token-space, local-statistic, and observation-space prediction discrepancies across temporal scales as a structured risk representation. A downstream task-adaptive detector uses anomaly labels to learn which discrepancy combinations signal target anomalies.
ykR0H995N8.key_idea: Preserves multiscale token, local-statistic, and observation prediction discrepancies from a hierarchical next-token predictor as structured features for a label-supervised detector.
ykR0H995N8.evidence: Evaluated on TSB-AD-U, TSB-AD-M, and both TAB tracks with controlled comparisons and case studies.
ykR0H995N8.claimed_gains: Improves VUS-PR by 12.0% on TSB-AD-U and 15.5% on TSB-AD-M over the strongest baselines and achieves the highest composite score on both TAB tracks.

nYZRJn4Xcc.one_liner: Prunes structured LLM groups greedily via a quadratic reconstruction objective capturing weight alignment, activation correlations, and gradient sensitivity.
nYZRJn4Xcc.problem: Structured LLM pruning must account for interactions among removed units whose combined effects can amplify or cancel in layer outputs.
nYZRJn4Xcc.method: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning (CASP) formulates a binary quadratic reconstruction criterion incorporating pairwise weight alignment and activation correlations, aggregates interactions into group-level decisions for greedy selection, and uses end-to-end loss gradients to allocate per-layer sparsity budgets.
nYZRJn4Xcc.key_idea: Aggregates pairwise weight-alignment and activation-correlation terms into a group-level quadratic program solved greedily with gradient-guided layer sparsity allocation.
nYZRJn4Xcc.evidence: Evaluated on mainstream LLMs against representative structured pruning baselines.

MbatJIvcFs.one_liner: Builds 1,648 verifiable multi-language repository sandboxes via feedback repair and pairs them with a role-isolated program-reproduction agent.
MbatJIvcFs.problem: Training coding agents to reproduce programs from scratch lacks scalable verifiable environments and workflows capable of sustaining long-horizon exploration and implementation.
MbatJIvcFs.method: ProgramGym combines Program-Env, a feedback-driven pipeline that repairs sandbox builds and black-box tests across repositories to yield 1,648 environments in C, C++, Go, and Rust, with Program-Agent, a role-isolated analysis, implementation, and review workflow featuring revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery.
MbatJIvcFs.key_idea: Synthesizes verifiable repository-level sandboxes via automated build-and-test repair and executes long-horizon reproduction through a role-isolated analysis-implementation-review agent with revision management.
MbatJIvcFs.evidence: Evaluated on ProgramBench by testing Program-Agent and fine-tuning Qwen3.8-27B on trajectories collected across the 1,648 constructed environments.
MbatJIvcFs.claimed_gains: Fine-tuning on trajectories from the constructed environments raises Qwen3.8-27B performance from 34.87% (final number truncated in abstract).

Hf7k3nH6E0.one_liner: Uses verifier-grounded execution failures to co-evolve agent environment support and policy optimization.
Hf7k3nH6E0.problem: During interactive agent training, policies evolve while learning environments stay static, creating Agent-Learning Environment Misalignment.
Hf7k3nH6E0.method: SEAL converts verifier-grounded execution failures into a shared diagnostic signal that drives both environment and policy adaptation. It reshapes interaction support in the learning environment to match the agent's current failure profile while adjusting how the policy learns from collected trajectories.
Hf7k3nH6E0.key_idea: Turns verifier-grounded execution failures into a shared diagnostic signal that simultaneously adapts environment support and trajectory-level policy optimization.
Hf7k3nH6E0.evidence: Evaluated across three backbones (including Qwen2.5-7B) on BFCL V3 with transfer to BFCL V4 and tau2-bench, plus a matched factorial ablation.
Hf7k3nH6E0.claimed_gains: Reaches 40.25% versus 30.75% for Vanilla RL on BFCL V3 with Qwen2.5-7B, with a +5.00-point coupled interaction estimate in matched factorial ablation.

EotWiMkCQc.one_liner: Generates simulation-ready 3D tabletop scenes via hierarchical executable programs refined by geometric and physics checks.
EotWiMkCQc.problem: Existing 3D tabletop scene generators produce static meshes with limited articulation and lack verification for physical simulation validity and robot executability.
EotWiMkCQc.method: TACER uses asset-level executable programs to build articulated geometry and physical representations and scene-level programs to arrange spatial layouts, iteratively revising assets or layouts using geometric checks and simulation tests. The authors also introduce the 500-case TabletopAudit benchmark and the 11,399-scene TACER-11K dataset.
EotWiMkCQc.key_idea: Synthesizes articulated assets and layouts as hierarchical executable programs and iteratively refines them using geometric and physics-simulation verification.
EotWiMkCQc.evidence: Evaluated on TabletopAudit (500 cases) and Embodied-100 against TabletopGen and TabletopGen + Articraft, plus construction of TACER-11K across nine environments.
EotWiMkCQc.claimed_gains: Achieves 71.67% rigid-manipulation and 60.00% articulated task success on Embodied-100, compared with 20.00% for TabletopGen and 5.00% for TabletopGen + Articraft.

jvtC7HjhAB.one_liner: Compresses long video history into ultra-compact hierarchical Q-Former tokens trained with generative loss.
jvtC7HjhAB.problem: Conditioning video generators on minutes of visual history incurs prohibitive memory and compute costs.
jvtC7HjhAB.method: GenMem compresses video frames into a compact hierarchical memory using a Q-Former-based token compressor that prioritizes semantics, appearance, and dynamics. Training the memory encoder directly with the video generation loss rather than reconstruction loss preserves generation-relevant semantics at higher compression.
jvtC7HjhAB.key_idea: Trains a hierarchical Q-Former video token compressor end-to-end with generation loss instead of reconstruction loss to pack 4 480p frames into 32 tokens.
jvtC7HjhAB.evidence: Long-context video generation experiments evaluating multi-minute scene and object consistency (specific benchmarks not stated).
jvtC7HjhAB.claimed_gains: Compresses 4 video frames at 480p resolution into 32 tokens while preserving long-context consistency.

oauW9dlXcI.one_liner: Identifies compositional generalization as an alternative to theoretically unidentifiable direct generalization in LLM model editing.
oauW9dlXcI.problem: Model editing evaluated under direct input-output generalization appears brittle, yet classical edits generalize fluently in modern interactive chatbots.
oauW9dlXcI.method: The authors show that direct generalization suffers from theoretical unidentifiability, bias ambiguity, and sensitivity to optimization dynamics. They instead characterize compositional generalization, where edited facts compose with modern LLMs' reasoning abilities in context.
oauW9dlXcI.key_idea: Shows direct editing generalization is theoretically unidentifiable and frames successful multi-step edit propagation as compositional generalization driven by LLM reasoning.
oauW9dlXcI.evidence: Theoretical identifiability analysis and empirical validation across multiple LLMs and classical model editing methods.

9uOw4C9OT9.one_liner: Proves SAE co-activation direction reduces to support-size frequency rather than semantic hierarchy.
9uOw4C9OT9.problem: Co-activation containment in sparse autoencoders is used to infer parent-child concept hierarchies, conflating semantic relatedness with taxonomic direction.
9uOw4C9OT9.method: The authors prove algebraically that shared features cancel in reciprocal coverage on non-tied pairs, reducing inferred direction to support-set size, and show that L0 sparsity in binary chains favors frequent states at shallow depths with L! observational ambiguity. They test WordNet parent-child orientation on a Llama-3.1-8B JumpReLU SAE.
9uOw4C9OT9.key_idea: Shows shared SAE features cancel in reciprocal coverage so inferred hierarchy reduces to support-set size and corpus frequency, with L0 sparsity unable to identify latent order.
9uOw4C9OT9.evidence: Algebraic and binary-chain identifiability proofs plus evaluation on 5,572 WordNet parent-child pairs using a Llama-3.1-8B JumpReLU SAE.
9uOw4C9OT9.claimed_gains: Reciprocal-coverage accuracy is 79.1% when child-to-parent corpus-frequency ratio is below 1 but drops to 25.3% otherwise; predicting the more frequent word scores 66.1% versus 61.1% for reciprocal coverage.

Nc1FWHSZHn.one_liner: Trains UAV navigation policies with geometric representation alignment and a distance-based collision-risk penalty during imitation learning.
Nc1FWHSZHn.problem: Vanilla imitation learning for UAV vision-language navigation treats safe open-space demonstrations and risky near-obstacle demonstrations as equally desirable supervision.
Nc1FWHSZHn.method: GeoRisk-IL augments imitation learning with a collision-risk penalty computed from distances between predicted future UAV locations and obstacles. It pairs this penalty with geometric representation alignment to strengthen the model's 3D spatial awareness without adding inference-time compute.
Nc1FWHSZHn.key_idea: Penalize predicted actions by future UAV-to-obstacle distance while aligning internal representations to 3D geometry during training.

kCoNU8YJmt.one_liner: Reconstructs multimodal 3D Gaussian scenes via shared spectral features, modality response operators, and RGB-guided pose alignment.
kCoNU8YJmt.problem: Modality-dependent sensor appearance and inaccurate auxiliary-camera poses hinder learning compact, reusable multimodal 3D scene representations.
kCoNU8YJmt.method: PoseSpecGS introduces Spectrum-Response Rendering, which renders each modality from alpha-composited shared Gaussian spectral features using compact modality-channel response operators. Its Cross-Modal Alignment registers auxiliary-modality cameras to an RGB SfM backbone and jointly refines poses and scene parameters via RGB-guided reprojection consistency.
kCoNU8YJmt.key_idea: Render multiple sensor modalities through compact response operators over shared Gaussian spectral features while refining auxiliary poses via RGB reprojection consistency.
kCoNU8YJmt.evidence: Evaluated on static, time-conditioned, and zero-shot RGB-supervised multimodal novel-view synthesis benchmarks (specific dataset names not stated).

slkIMkRq1L.one_liner: Injects unforgeable span annotations into a frozen LLM's residual stream via small adapters to block prompt injection.
slkIMkRq1L.problem: LLMs receive trust metadata only as plain text, allowing injected instructions in untrusted spans to masquerade as user or system prompts.
slkIMkRq1L.method: Semantic Overlays attach small trained adapters that edit a frozen LLM's residual stream at harness-selected token spans, creating an out-of-band annotation channel that input text cannot forge or strip. Marking retrieved spans as non-executable trains the model to treat embedded instructions as inert content while leaving unmarked inference unchanged.
slkIMkRq1L.key_idea: Edit a frozen LLM's residual stream at harness-specified token spans with trained adapters to provide unforgeable non-executable annotations.
slkIMkRq1L.evidence: Evaluated on SEP, AlpacaFarm, AgentDojo, and four PIArena attack families against attacks unaware of the defense, plus fine-tuning controls.
slkIMkRq1L.claimed_gains: Raises SEP separation from 24.3% to 98.8% under a corrected grader, lowers AlpacaFarm attack success from 99.0% to 0.5%, and lowers AgentDojo attack success from 12.8% to 0% (with 0% across all four PIArena families in the TL;DR).

g0bM6LLuuO.one_liner: Adapts per-location normal prototypes at test time using dual anomaly scoring, counter-weighted updates, and consistency weighting.
g0bM6LLuuO.problem: Static few-shot industrial inspection flags benign batch shifts as anomalies, while feature-indexed online updates discard fixed-viewpoint spatial correspondence.
g0bM6LLuuO.method: TPA keeps the feature encoder frozen and stores one normal prototype token and update counter per spatial location. Dual anomaly scoring admits only low-scoring patches into counter-weighted per-location prototype updates, while dynamic attention weighting reweights anomaly maps by each location's stream-level consistency.
g0bM6LLuuO.key_idea: Maintain location-indexed normal prototypes updated via counter-weighted means of low-scoring patches and reweight anomaly maps by temporal location consistency.
g0bM6LLuuO.evidence: Evaluated on three anomaly detection benchmarks and one few-shot segmentation benchmark (dataset names not stated).
g0bM6LLuuO.claimed_gains: Adds 0.09 ms per image and 11 GFLOPs over the frozen reference while recovering 5.6 points of image-level AUROC over the static configuration, with AUROC varying by at most 0.7 points.

Y8YqOzxVNl.one_liner: Couples pretrained global weather models with kilometer-scale regional forecasting through grid conversion and aligned local dynamics.
Y8YqOzxVNl.problem: Data-driven regional weather forecasting relies on numerical global guidance or retraining global models due to cross-grid representation mismatch.
Y8YqOzxVNl.method: ScaleCast introduces a Global-Regional Conversion module that maps joint global and regional features onto regional locations, followed by a Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block that merges aligned global guidance with local neighborhood interactions. A single trained regional model works across multiple pretrained global forecast drivers without driver-specific retraining.
Y8YqOzxVNl.key_idea: Align global and regional representations onto regional grid points and fuse them with local neighborhood interactions to advance kilometer-scale states.
Y8YqOzxVNl.evidence: Evaluated using ERA5 (0.25°), CERRA (5.5 km), and fine-tuning on HRRR (3 km) with Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES as global drivers.

64VOGvGtGF.one_liner: Parameterizes continuous-time user preference flows without ODE solvers using personalized temporal gates and co-occurrence-initialized item states.
64VOGvGtGF.problem: Neural ODE-based continuous-time sequential recommenders incur high inference latency from numerical integration, forcing an accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
64VOGvGtGF.method: Personalized Gated Neural Flow (PGNF) directly parameterizes a continuous-time flow map with a user-specific temporal gating mechanism to evolve interacted item states over irregular intervals. It also injects time-aware collaborative signals from an item co-occurrence graph into initial item states without adding inference overhead.
64VOGvGtGF.key_idea: Replace numerical ODE integration with a solver-free personalized gated flow map initialized from a temporally weighted item co-occurrence graph.
64VOGvGtGF.evidence: Evaluated on real-world sequential recommendation datasets across diverse domains and scales (dataset names not stated).

hrbXJ7zUf8.one_liner: Trains an autoregressive normalizing-flow world model with an invertible encoder and probabilistic predictor via exact maximum likelihood.
hrbXJ7zUf8.problem: Diffusion video world models need costly multi-step denoising, whereas JEPA latent world models need anti-collapse tricks and use deterministic predictors.
hrbXJ7zUf8.method: Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM) pairs an invertible encoder with a probabilistic latent predictor and trains both jointly by exact maximum likelihood. Invertibility enables future observation generation, while single-step probabilistic latent prediction supports multi-future modeling and planning without extra anti-collapse mechanisms.
hrbXJ7zUf8.key_idea: Jointly train an invertible encoder and probabilistic latent predictor via exact maximum likelihood to prevent collapse and enable one-step prediction and decoding.

1t284t9Cvm.one_liner: Maintains persistent video world-model memory without training via camera-based KV chunk retrieval and anchor-similarity token pruning.
1t284t9Cvm.problem: Autoregressive video diffusion models lose long-term spatial consistency under sliding windows, while full KV-cache attention breaks real-time speed and memory limits.
1t284t9Cvm.method: WorldKV is a training-free memory framework with two modules: World Retrieval selects relevant historical KV chunks via camera and action correspondence and reinserts them into the attention window without re-encoding. World Compression prunes redundant tokens within each chunk using key-key similarity to an anchor frame.
1t284t9Cvm.key_idea: Retrieve historical KV chunks by camera/action viewpoint overlap and prune redundant intra-chunk tokens via key-key similarity to an anchor frame.
1t284t9Cvm.evidence: Evaluated on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast against Full KV memory.
1t284t9Cvm.claimed_gains: Halves per-chunk storage to fit 2x more history under a fixed budget and matches or exceeds Full KV memory fidelity at roughly 2x the throughput on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast.

G7btG9LR60.one_liner: Encodes pairwise image preferences into a reusable profile to predict query-conditioned 3D LUTs without per-user optimization.
G7btG9LR60.problem: Existing LUT and reference-guided color editors match a single target look rather than modeling persistent, refinable user preferences from repeated choices.
G7btG9LR60.method: PrefLUT encodes ordered preferred/non-preferred image pairs into a compact Reusable User Profile that is combined with each query image to predict a LUT latent vector and edit strength, decoded into an exportable 3D LUT. The authors also introduce PCVP to test sensitivity to profiles, preference order, pair correspondence, and query images.
G7btG9LR60.key_idea: Encode pairwise preference comparisons into a compact reusable user profile that conditions an identity-residual 3D LUT decoder and edit-strength controller.
G7btG9LR60.evidence: Evaluated on three datasets (names not stated) for personalized editing and general enhancement, plus the proposed PCVP verification protocol.
G7btG9LR60.claimed_gains: Each quantized user profile requires 260 bytes, and editing runs in 1.365 ms/image on an RTX 5090 GPU.

0luMFw8Art.one_liner: Models multimodal human reward distributions by conditioning a lightweight Diffusion Transformer on a frozen LLM encoder.
0luMFw8Art.problem: Scalar and fixed-parametric reward models cannot capture inherently multimodal human preferences and disagreement over the same prompt-response pair.
0luMFw8Art.method: Diffusion Reward Model (DRM) frames reward modeling as conditional density estimation by denoising Gaussian noise into a reward vector with a lightweight Diffusion Transformer conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder. One architecture supports multi-attribute regression and pairwise preferences, sampling N rewards at inference to compute means, variances, quantiles, or lower-confidence bounds.
0luMFw8Art.key_idea: Train a Diffusion Transformer conditioned on a frozen LLM encoder to sample nonparametric multimodal reward vectors at inference.
0luMFw8Art.evidence: Evaluated across five benchmarks (names not stated) against discriminative, distributional, and generative reward models under matched data and backbones.

Du2UqwkSS8.one_liner: Benchmarks coding agents on end-to-end static-analysis checker synthesis across 300 CVE-derived repository tasks with independent rebuild evaluation.
Du2UqwkSS8.problem: Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on patch generation or bug detection and rarely test end-to-end synthesis of working static-analysis checkers.
Du2UqwkSS8.method: The authors introduce CheckerBench, 300 executable checker-synthesis tasks built from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems, each with vulnerable/fixed revisions, pinned analysis environments, and scaffolds. They pair it with CheckerLab to independently rebuild checkers and score vulnerable-fixed contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use.
Du2UqwkSS8.key_idea: Evaluate end-to-end static-analysis checker synthesis by independently rebuilding agent-authored checkers against vulnerable and fixed CVE repository revisions.
Du2UqwkSS8.evidence: Evaluated 21 model-harness configurations with three independent repeats each on the 300-task CheckerBench benchmark.
Du2UqwkSS8.claimed_gains: Across 21 model-harness configurations, mean Pass@1 is 30.81% and the best configuration reaches 40.67%.

7GVjfxEXUH.one_liner: Pretrains a frozen Transformer compatibility scorer on synthetic structural-causal-model data to replace handcrafted multimodal contrastive similarities.
7GVjfxEXUH.problem: Multimodal contrastive learning relies on manually designed similarity functions like cosine similarity, which struggle to capture higher-order cross-modal dependencies.
7GVjfxEXUH.method: The authors replace handcrafted similarity metrics with a frozen Transformer scorer after finding that even a frozen random Transformer outperforms jointly optimized scorers. Their Prior-Fitted Scorer (PFS) pretrains this Transformer on synthetic multimodal data sampled from structural causal model priors before transferring it frozen to real-world contrastive learning.
7GVjfxEXUH.key_idea: Pretrain a Transformer compatibility scorer on synthetic structural-causal-model priors and keep it frozen during real-world multimodal contrastive training.
7GVjfxEXUH.evidence: Evaluated across four real-world multimodal datasets (names not stated) against handcrafted multimodal contrastive baselines.

5EzTXxDH66.one_liner: Improves medical MLLM test-time reinforcement learning by enforcing consistent visual grounding and localized clinical region exploration alongside consensus.
5EzTXxDH66.problem: Answer-consensus test-time RL in medical VQA can amplify shortcut reasoning, ignore cross-trajectory visual consistency, and get distracted by irrelevant image regions.
5EzTXxDH66.method: TALC is a dual-exploration test-time reinforcement learning framework for medical multimodal reasoning on unlabeled clinical data. It augments trajectory-consensus signals to prevent textual shortcuts, enforce consistent visual grounding across sampled trajectories, and focus exploration on localized clinically relevant regions.
5EzTXxDH66.key_idea: Combine answer consensus with cross-trajectory visual grounding consistency and localized clinical region exploration during test-time reinforcement learning.

J1Fhq8AyAk.one_liner: Benchmarks VLMs on human bodily action preconditions and action-induced readiness changes across 1,190 questions on 280 exocentric images.
J1Fhq8AyAk.problem: Existing planning benchmarks test task progression or object feasibility without isolating whether a specific person's visible bodily state permits an action.
J1Fhq8AyAk.method: The authors build BodyReady, a benchmark of 1,190 questions grounded in 280 exocentric images across six tasks covering action applicability, blocking conditions, enabling preparations, and where short action sequences become invalid. Reference answers are derived from human-reviewed hand use, posture, reachability, explicit action prerequisites, and bounded completion effects.
J1Fhq8AyAk.key_idea: Ground visual action applicability benchmarks in explicit human hand-use, posture, and reachability preconditions plus bounded post-action state transitions.
J1Fhq8AyAk.evidence: Evaluated 18 proprietary and open vision-language models on the 1,190-question BodyReady benchmark.
J1Fhq8AyAk.claimed_gains: Across 18 VLMs, the best model achieves 74.96% strict overall accuracy but only 63.85% on selecting currently applicable actions.

c2TBI8RzwD.one_liner: Tests whether LLM auditors verify multi-agent failure evidence or blindly relay upstream blame proposals via controlled proposal perturbations.
c2TBI8RzwD.problem: When auditing failed multi-agent pipelines, LLM judges may echo upstream agents' blamed step instead of verifying step-level observations.
c2TBI8RzwD.method: The authors hold agent observations fixed in a six-step supply-chain simulation and vary or delete the agents' suspected-origin proposal, as well as inject planted blame lines into public failure logs. They measure fault-attribution accuracy under original, planted, and deleted proposals to separate genuine verification from proposal relaying and anomaly-first shortcuts.
c2TBI8RzwD.key_idea: Hold multi-agent observations fixed while perturbing, planting, or deleting suspected-origin fields to isolate blame relaying from evidence verification in LLM auditors.
c2TBI8RzwD.evidence: Evaluated qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct and claude-sonnet-5 on a simulated six-step supply chain and 184 public multi-agent failure logs.
c2TBI8RzwD.claimed_gains: When proposals are wrong, qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct finds the true origin in 4.0% of episodes versus 59.7% from documentation alone; deleting the proposal raises accuracy by 38.3 percentage points when wrong but lowers it by 18.3 points when right.
